Padma Purāṇa, Brahma-khaṇḍa 25.15.text:
śivasya śrī-viṣṇor ya iha guṇa-nāmādi-sakalaṁ
dhiyā bhinnaṁ paśyet sa khalu hari-nāmāhita-karaḥ
Padma Purāṇa, Brahma-khaṇḍa 25.15.translation: One who sees differences between any of Lord Śiva's qualities and names and those of Śrī Viṣṇu is an antagonist to harināma.

BB 1.2.43.text:
tad-ājñayā ca yajñeṣu
niyujyarṣīn nijātmajān
brahmāṇḍa-kārya-carcārthaṁ
svaṁ dhiṣṇyaṁ vidhir āgataḥ
BB 1.2.43.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 43

BB 1.2.62.text:
tan-māyayaiva satataṁ
jagato ’haṁ guruḥ prabhuḥ
pitāmahaś ca kṛṣṇasya
nābhi-padma-samudbhavaḥ
tapasvy ārādhakas tasyety-
ādyair guru-madair hataḥ
brahmāṇḍāvaśyakāpāra-
vyāpārāmarśa-vihvalaḥ
bhūta-prāyātma-lokīya-
nāśa-cintā-niyantritaḥ
sarva-grāsi-mahā-kālād
bhīto muktiṁ paraṁ vṛṇe
BB 1.2.62.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 62

BB 1.2.71.text:
tathāpi rāvaṇādibhyo
duṣṭebhyo ’haṁ varān adām
rāvaṇasya tu yat karma
jihvā kasya gṛṇāti tat
maivaṁ vibho ’surāṇāṁ te
BB 1.2.71.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 71

BB 1.2.72.text:
mayā dattādhikārāṇāṁ
śakrādīnāṁ mahā-madaiḥ
sadā hata-vivekānāṁ
tasminn āgāṁsi saṁsmara
BB 1.2.72.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 72

BB 1.2.73.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 73

BB 1.2.74.text:
yamasya ca tad-ācāryā-
tmaja-durmāraṇādinā
kuverasyāpi duśceṣṭa-
śaṅkhacūḍa-kṛtādinā
BB 1.2.74.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 74

BB 1.2.75.text:
adho loke tu daiteyā
vaiṣṇava-droha-kāriṇaḥ
sarpāś ca sahaja-krodha-
duṣṭāḥ kāliya-bāndhavāḥ
BB 1.2.75.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 75

BB 1.2.87-88.text:
śiva-datta-varonmattāt
tripureśvarato mayāt
tathā vṛkāsurādeś ca
saṅkaṭaṁ paramaṁ gataḥ
śivaḥ samuddhṛto ’nena
harṣitaś ca vaco-’mṛtaiḥ
tad-antaraṅga-sad-bhaktyā
kṛṣṇena vaśa-vartinā
svayam ārādhyate cāsya
māhātmya-bhara-siddhaye
aho deva mahādeva pāpo
BB 1.2.87-88.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 87-88

BB 1.2.91.text:
purāṇāny eva gāyanti
dayālutvaṁ harer hare
jñāyate hi tvayāpy etat
paraṁ ca smaryatāṁ mune
BB 1.2.91.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 91

BB 2.5.234.text:
cet kṛṣṇa-candrasya mahāvatāras
tādṛg nija-prema-vitāna-kārī
syād vā kadācid yadi rādhikāyāḥ
premānubhūtiṁ tad upaity athāpi
BB 2.5.234.translation: Should there ever be a full incarnation of Śrī Kṛṣṇa-candra to distribute pure Kṛṣṇa-prema, to experience the Kṛṣṇa-prema of Śrīmatī Rādhikā, you might be able to understand it.

Caitanya-candrāmṛta 5.translation: When one receives the merciful sidelong glance of Lord Caitanya, the conception of liberation becomes like hell.

Kūrma Purāṇa (brahmaṇā saha).text: brahmaṇā sahate sarve samprapte prati-sañcare parasyante kṛtātmanāḥ prati-saṅkhāre viśyanti paramaṁ padam
Kūrma Purāṇa (brahmaṇā saha).translation: Those who are on Brahmaloka with exalted status at the time of dissolution go directly to the Supreme Abode along with Lord Brahmā.

SB 5.19.21.text:
etad eva hi deva gayanti aho amīṣāṁ kim akāri śobhanaṁ
prasannā eṣāṁ svid uta svayaṁ hariḥ
yajjanma labdhaṁ nṛṣu bhāratājire
mukunda-sevaupayikaṁ spṛhā hi naḥ
SB 5.19.21.translation: Since the human form of life is the sublime position for spiritual realization, all the demigods in heaven speak: 'How wonderful it is for these human beings to have been born in the land of Bhāratavarṣa. We devas can only aspire to achieve human births in Bhāratavarṣa to execute devotional service.'

BB 1.2.51.text:
yasmin nityaṁ vaset sākṣān
mahā-puruṣa-vigrahaḥ
sa padmanābho yajñānāṁ
bhāgān aśnan dadat phalam
BB 1.2.51.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 51

BB 1.2.52.text:
paramānveṣaṇāyāsair
yasyoddeśo ’pi na tvayā
purā prāptaḥ paraṁ dṛṣṭas
tapobhir hṛdi yaḥ kṣaṇam
BB 1.2.52.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 52

BB 1.4.25.text:
brahma-tat-tanayādīnāṁ
kartuṁ vāk-satyatām api
nija-bhakti-mahattvaṁ ca
samyag darśayituṁ param
aprameyānubhāvo ’yam
ayaṁ niṣkilbiṣaḥ sākṣān
BB 1.4.25.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 4, Text 25

CC Antya 4.176.text:
'dvaite' bhadrābhadra-jñāna, saba — 'manodharma'
'ei bhāla, ei manda', — ei saba 'bhrama'
CC Antya 4.176.translation: In the material world, conceptions of good and bad are all mental speculations. Thinking 'this is good' and 'this is bad' is all a mistake.

BB 2.7.8.text:
bhavataś cātra viśvāso nitarāṁ samāpadyata
lakṣaṇair lakṣitaś cāyaṁ mayā śīghra-phala-pradaḥ
BB 2.7.8.translation: I have noted clear signs that you have gained strong faith in these topics, a faith that will soon bestow upon you all its rewards.

BB 1.2.54.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
itthaṁ māhātmyam udgāyan
vistārya brahmaṇo ’sakṛt
śakra-proktaṁ sva-dṛṣṭaṁ ca
bhaktyāsīt taṁ naman muniḥ
BB 1.2.54.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 54

BB 1.2.55.text:
śṛṇvann eva sa tad-vākyaṁ
dāso ’smīti muhur vadan
catur-vaktro ’ṣṭa-karṇānāṁ
pidhāne vyagratāṁ gataḥ
BB 1.2.55.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 55

BB 1.2.56.text:
aśravya-śravaṇāj jātaṁ
kopaṁ yatnena dhārayan
sva-putraṁ nāradaṁ prāha
sākṣepaṁ catur-ānanaḥ
BB 1.2.56.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 56

BB 1.2.57.text:
śrī-brahmovāca
ahaṁ na bhagavān kṛṣṇa
iti tvaṁ kiṁ pramāṇataḥ
yuktitaś ca mayābhīkṣṇaṁ
bodhito ’si na bālyataḥ
BB 1.2.57.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 57

BB 1.2.58.text:
tasya śaktir mahā-māyā
dāsīvekṣā-pathe sthitā
sṛjatīdaṁ jagat pāti
sva-guṇaiḥ saṁharaty api
BB 1.2.58.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 58

BB 1.2.59.text:
tasyā eva vayaṁ sarve
’py adhīnā mohitās tayā
tan na kṛṣṇa-kṛpā-leśasy-
āpi pātram avehi mām
BB 1.2.59.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 59

BB 1.2.63.text:
tad-arthaṁ bhagavat-pūjāṁ
kārayāmi karomi ca
āvāso jagad-īśasya
tasya vā na kva vidyate
BB 1.2.63.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 63

BB 1.2.64.text:
veda-pravartanāyāsau
bhāgaṁ gṛhṇāti kevalam
svayaṁ-sampādita-preṣṭha-
yajñasyānugrahāya ca
BB 1.2.64.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 64

BB 1.2.65.text:
vicārācārya budhyasva
sa hi bhakty-eka-vallabhaḥ
kṛpāṁ tanoti bhakteṣu
nābhakteṣu kadācana
BB 1.2.65.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 65

BB 1.2.66.text:
bhaktir dūre ’stu tasmin me
nāparādhā bhavanti cet
bahu manye tad ātmānaṁ
nāham āgaḥsu rudra-vat
BB 1.2.66.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 66

BB 1.2.67.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 67

BB 1.2.68-69.text:
śrīman-nṛsiṁha-rūpeṇa prabhuṇā saṁhṛto yadā
tadāhaṁ sa-parivāro vicitra-stava-pāṭavaiḥ
stuvan sthitvā bhayād dūre 'pāṅga-dṛṣṭyāpi nādṛtaḥ
prahlādasyābhiṣeke tu vṛtte tasmin prasādataḥ
BB 1.2.68-69.translation: After the Lord in his form as Nṛsiṁhadeva destroyed Hiraṇyakaśipu, I and my entourage stood fearful at a distance, trying to praise the Lord with skillful prayers, but he would not even honor us with a sidelong glance. Yet when Prahlāda was inaugurated king, the Lord at once became pacified.

BB 1.2.70.text:
śanair upasṛto ’bhyarṇam
ādiṣṭo ’ham idaṁ ruṣā
maivaṁ varo ’surāṇāṁ te
pradeyaḥ padma-sambhava
BB 1.2.70.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 70

BB 1.2.76.text:
sampraty api mayā tasya
svayaṁ vatsās tathārbhakāḥ

bhojane māyayā hṛtāḥ
BB 1.2.76.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 76

BS 5.29.text:
cintāmaṇi-prakara-sadmasu kalpa-vṛkṣa-
lakṣāvṛteṣu surabhīr abhipālayantam
lakṣmī-sahasra-śata-sambhrama-sevyamānaṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.29.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, the first progenitor who is tending the cows, yielding all desire, in abodes built with spiritual gems, surrounded by millions of purpose trees, always served with great reverence and affection by hundreds of thousands of lakṣmīs or gopīs.

BS 5.43.text:
goloka-nāmni nija-dhāmni tale ca tasya
devi maheśa-hari-dhāmasu teṣu teṣu
te te prabhāva-nicayā vihitāś ca yena
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.43.translation: Lowest of all is located Devī-dhāma [mundane world], next above it is Maheśa-dhāma [abode of Maheśa]; above Maheśa-dhāma is placed Hari-dhāma [abode of Hari] and above them all is located Kṛṣṇa's own realm named Goloka. I adore the primeval Lord Govinda, who has allotted their respective authorities to the rulers of those graded realms.

BS 5.1.text:
īśvaraḥ paramaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ
sac-cid-ānanda-vigrahaḥ
anādir ādir govindaḥ
sarva-kāraṇa-kāraṇam
BS 5.1.translation: Kṛṣṇa who is known as Govinda is the Supreme Godhead. He has an eternal blissful spiritual body. He is the origin of all. He has no other origin and He is the prime cause of all causes.

BS 5.2.text:
sahasra-patra-kamalaṁ
gokulākhyaṁ mahat padam
tat-karṇikāraṁ tad-dhāma
tad-anantāṁśa-sambhavam
BS 5.2.translation: The superexcellent station of Kṛṣṇa, which is known as Gokula, has thousands of petals and a corolla like that of a lotus sprouted from a part of His infinitary aspect, the whorl of the leaves being the actual abode of Kṛṣṇa.

BS 5.3.text:
karṇikāraṁ mahad yantraṁ
ṣaṭ-koṇaṁ vajra-kīlakam
ṣaḍ-aṅga-ṣaṭ-padī-sthānaṁ
prakṛtyā puruṣeṇa ca
premānanda-mahānanda-
rasenāvasthitaṁ hi yat
jyotī-rūpeṇa manunā
kāma-bījena saṅgatam
BS 5.3.translation: The whorl of that transcendental lotus is the realm wherein dwells Kṛṣṇa. It is a hexagonal figure, the abode of the indwelling predominated and predominating aspect of the Absolute.

BS 5.4.translation: The whorl of that eternal realm Gokula is the hexagonal abode of Kṛṣṇa. Its petals are the abodes of gopīs who are part and parcel of Kṛṣṇa to whom they are most lovingly devoted and are similar in essence.

BS 5.5.text:
catur-asraṁ tat-paritaḥ
śvetadvīpākhyam adbhutam
catur-asraṁ catur-mūrteś
catur-dhāma catuṣ-kṛtam
caturbhiḥ puruṣārthaiś ca
caturbhir hetubhir vṛtam
śūlair daśabhir ānaddham
ūrdhvādho dig-vidikṣv api
aṣṭabhir nidhibhir juṣṭam
aṣṭabhiḥ siddhibhis tathā
manu-rūpaiś ca daśabhir
dik-pālaiḥ parito vṛtam
śyāmair gauraiś ca raktaiś ca
śuklaiś ca pārṣadarṣabhaiḥ
śobhitaṁ śaktibhis tābhir
adbhutābhiḥ samantataḥ
BS 5.5.translation: There is a mysterious quadrangular place named Śvetadvīpa surrounding the outskirts of Gokula. Śvetadvīpa is divided into four parts on all sides.

BS 5.6.text:
evaṁ jyotir-mayo devaḥ
sad-ānandaḥ parāt paraḥ
ātmārāmasya tasyāsti
prakṛtyā na samāgamaḥ
BS 5.6.translation: The Lord of Gokula is the transcendental Supreme Godhead, the own Self of eternal ecstasies. He is the superior of all superiors and is busily engaged in the enjoyments of the transcendental realm and has no association with His mundane potency.

BS 5.7.text:
māyayāramamāṇasya
na viyogas tayā saha
ātmanā ramayā reme
tyakta-kālaṁ sisṛkṣayā
BS 5.7.translation: Kṛṣṇa never consorts with His illusory energy. Still her connection is not entirely cut off from the Absolute Truth.

BS 5.8.text:
niyatiḥ sā ramā devi
tat-priyā tad-vaśaṁ tadā
tal-liṅgaṁ bhagavān śambhur
jyoti-rūpaḥ sanātanaḥ
yā yoniḥ sāparā śaktiḥ
kāmo bījaṁ mahad dhareḥ
BS 5.8.translation: Ramādevī, the spiritual potency, beloved consort of the Supreme Lord, is the regulatrix of all entities. The divine plenary portion of Kṛṣṇa creates the mundane world.

BS 5.9.translation: All offspring of the consort of the great lord of this mundane world are of the nature of the embodiment of the mundane masculine and feminine generative organs.

BS 5.10.text:
śaktimān puruṣaḥ so 'yaṁ
liṅga-rūpī maheśvaraḥ
tasminn āvirabhūl liṅge
mahā-viṣṇur jagat-patiḥ
BS 5.10.translation: The person embodying the material causal principle, viz., the great lord of this mundane world Śambhu, in the form of the male generating organ, is joined to his female consort the limited energy as the efficient causal principle.

BS 5.11.text:
sahasra-śīrṣā puruṣaḥ
sahasrākṣaḥ sahasra-pāt
sahasra-bāhur viśvātmā
sahasrāṁśaḥ sahasra-sūḥ
BS 5.11.translation: The Lord of the mundane world, Mahā-Viṣṇu, possesses thousands of thousands of heads, eyes, hands. He is the source of thousands of thousands of avatāras in His thousands of thousands of subjective portions.

BS 5.12.text:
nārāyaṇaḥ sa bhagavān
āpas tasmāt sanātanāt
āvirāsīt kāraṇārṇo
nidhiḥ saṅkarṣaṇātmakaḥ
yoga-nidrāṁ gatas tasmin
sahasrāṁśaḥ svayaṁ mahān
BS 5.12.translation: The same Mahā-Viṣṇu is spoken of by the name of 'Nārāyaṇa' in this mundane world. From that eternal person has sprung the vast expanse of water of the spiritual Causal Ocean.

BS 5.13.text:
tad-roma-bila jāleṣu
bījaṁ saṅkarṣaṇasya ca
haimāny aṇḍāni jātāni
mahā-bhūtāvṛtāni tu
BS 5.13.translation: The spiritual seeds of Saṅkarṣaṇa existing in the pores of skin of Mahā-Viṣṇu, are born as so many golden sperms. These sperms are covered with five great elements.

BS 5.14.text:
praty-aṇḍam evam ekāṁśād
ekāṁśād viśati svayam
sahasra-mūrdhā viśvātmā
mahā-viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
BS 5.14.translation: The same Mahā-Viṣṇu entered into each universe as His own separate subjective portions.

BS 5.15.text:
vāmāṅgād asṛjad viṣṇuṁ
dakṣiṇāṅgāt prajāpatim
jyotir-liṅga-mayaṁ śambhuṁ
kūrca-deśād avāsṛjat
BS 5.15.translation: The same Mahā-Viṣṇu created Viṣṇu from His left limb, Brahmā, the first progenitor of beings, from His right limb and, from the space between His two eyebrows, Śambhu, the divine masculine manifested halo.

BS 5.16.translation: The function of Śambhu in relation to jīvas is that this universe enshrining the mundane egotistic principle has originated from Śambhu.

BS 5.17.text:
atha tais tri-vidhair veśair
līlām udvahataḥ kila
yoga-nidrā bhagavatī
tasya śrīr iva saṅgatā
BS 5.17.translation: Thereupon the same great personal Godhead, assuming the threefold forms of Viṣṇu, Prajāpati and Śambhu, entering into the mundane universe, plays the pastimes of preservation, creation and destruction of this world.

BS 5.18.text:
sisṛkṣāyāṁ tato nābhes
tasya padmaṁ viniryayau
tan-nālaṁ hema-nalinaṁ
brahmaṇo lokam adbhutam
BS 5.18.translation: When Viṣṇu lying in the ocean of milk wills to create this universe, a golden lotus springs from His navel-pit. The golden lotus with its stem is the abode of Brahmā representing Brahmaloka or Satyaloka.

BS 5.19.text:
tattvāni pūrva-rūḍhāni
kāraṇāni parasparam
samavāyāprayogāc ca
vibhinnāni pṛthak pṛthak
cic-chaktyā sajjamāno 'tha
bhagavān ādi-pūruṣaḥ
yojayan māyayā devo
yoga-nidrām akalpayat
BS 5.19.translation: Before their conglomeration the primary elements in their nascent state remained originally separate entities. Divine Mahā-Viṣṇu, primal Godhead, through association with His own spiritual potency, moved Māyā.

BS 5.20.text:
yojayitvā tu tāny eva
praviveśa svayaṁ guhām
guhāṁ praviṣṭe tasmiṁs tu
jīvātmā pratibudhyate
BS 5.20.translation: By conglomerating all those separate entities He manifested the innumerable mundane universes and Himself entered into the inmost recess of every extended conglomerate. At that time those jīvas who had lain dormant during the cataclysm were awakened.

BS 5.21.text:
sa nityo nitya-sambandhaḥ
prakṛtiś ca paraiva sā
BS 5.21.translation: The same jīva is eternal and is for eternity and without a beginning joined to the Supreme Lord by the tie of an eternal kinship. He is transcendental spiritual potency.

BS 5.22.text:
evaṁ sarvātma-sambandhaṁ
nābhyāṁ padmaṁ harer abhūt
tatra brahmābhavad bhūyaś
catur-vedi catur-mukhaḥ
BS 5.22.translation: The divine lotus which springs from the navel-pit of Viṣṇu is in every way related by the spiritual tie with all souls and is the origin of four-faced Brahmā versed in the four Vedas.

BS 5.23.text:
sañjāto bhagavac-chaktyā
tat-kālaṁ kila coditaḥ
sisṛkṣāyāṁ matiṁ cakre
pūrva-saṁskāra-saṁskṛtaḥ
dardarśa kevalaṁ dhvāntaṁ
nānyat kim api sarvataḥ
BS 5.23.translation: On coming out of the lotus, Brahmā, being guided by the divine potency tuned his mind to the act of creation under the impulse of previous impressions. But he could see nothing but darkness in every direction.

BS 5.24.text:
uvāca puratas tasmai
tasya divyā sarasvatī
kāma-kṛṣṇāya govinda
he gopī-jana ity api
vallabhāya priyā vahner
mantram te dāsyati priyam
BS 5.24.translation: Then the goddess of learning Sarasvatī, the divine consort of the Supreme Lord, said thus to Brahmā who saw nothing but gloom in all directions, 'O Brahmā, this mantra will assuredly fulfill your heart's desire.'

BS 5.25.text:
tapas tvaṁ tapa etena
tava siddhir bhaviṣyati
BS 5.25.translation: 'O Brahmā, do thou practice spiritual association by means of this mantra; then all your desires will be fulfilled.'

BS 5.26.text:
atha tepe sa suciraṁ
prīṇan govindam avyayam
śvetadvīpa-patiṁ kṛṣṇaṁ
goloka-sthaṁ parāt param
prakṛtyā guṇa-rūpiṇyā
rūpiṇyā paryupāsitam
sahasra-dala-sampanne
koṭi-kiñjalka-bṛṁhite
bhūmiś cintāmaṇis tatra
karṇikāre mahāsane
samāsīnaṁ cid-ānandaṁ
jyoti-rūpaṁ sanātanam
śabda-brahma-mayaṁ veṇuṁ
vādayantaṁ mukhāmbuje
vilāsinī-gaṇa-vṛtaṁ
svaiḥ svair aṁśair abhiṣṭutam
BS 5.26.translation: Brahmā, being desirous of satisfying Govinda, practiced the cultural acts for Kṛṣṇa in Goloka, Lord of Śvetadvīpa, for a long time.

BS 5.27.text:
atha veṇu-ninādasya
trayī-mūrti-mayī gatiḥ
sphurantī praviveśāśu
mukhābjāni svayambhuvaḥ
gāyatrīṁ gāyatas tasmād
adhigatya sarojajaḥ
saṁskṛtaś cādi-gunuṇā
dvijatām agamat tataḥ
BS 5.27.translation: Then Gāyatrī, mother of the Vedas, being made manifest by the divine sound of the flute of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, entered into the lotus mouth of Brahmā. The lotus-born Brahmā having received the Gāyatrī attained the status of the twice-born.

BS 5.28.text:
trayyā prabuddho 'tha vidhir
vījñāta-tattva-sāgaraḥ
tuṣṭāva veda-sāreṇa
stotreṇānena keśavam
BS 5.28.translation: Enlightened by the recollection of that Gāyatrī, embodying the three Vedas, Brahmā became acquainted with the expanse of the ocean of truth. Then he worshiped Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the essence of all Vedas, with this hymn.

BS 5.30.text:
veṇuṁ kvaṇantam aravinda-dalāyatākṣam-
barhāvataṁsam asitāmbuda-sundarāṅgam
kandarpa-koṭi-kamanīya-viśeṣa-śobhaṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.30.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, who is adept in playing on His flute, with blooming eyes like lotus petals with head decked with peacock's feather, with the figure of beauty tinged with the hue of blue clouds, and His unique loveliness charming millions of Cupids.

BS 5.31.text:
ālola-candraka-lasad-vanamālya-vaṁśī-
ratnāṅgadaṁ praṇaya-keli-kalā-vilāsam
śyāmaṁ tri-bhaṅga-lalitaṁ niyata-prakāśaṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.31.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, round whose neck is swinging a garland of flowers beautified with the moon-locket, whose two hands are adorned with the flute and jeweled ornaments, who always revels in pastimes of love, whose graceful threefold-bending form of Śyāmasundara is eternally manifest.

BS 5.32.text:
aṅgāni yasya sakalendriya-vṛtti-manti
paśyanti pānti kalayanti ciraṁ jaganti
ānanda-cinmaya-sad-ujjvala-vigrahasya
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.32.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, whose transcendental form is full of bliss, truth, substantiality and is thus full of the most dazzling splendor. Each of the limbs of that transcendental figure possesses in Himself, the full-fledged functions of all the organs.

BS 5.33.text:
advaitam acyutam anādim ananta-rūpam
ādyaṁ purāṇa-puruṣaṁ nava-yauvanaṁ ca
vedeṣu durlabham adurlabham ātma-bhaktau
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.33.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, who is inaccessible to the Vedas, but obtainable by pure unalloyed devotion of the soul, who is without a second, who is not subject to decay, is without a beginning, whose form is endless, who is the beginning, and the eternal puruṣa; yet He is a person possessing the beauty of blooming youth.

BS 5.34.text:
panthās tu koṭi-śata-vatsara-sampragamyo
vāyor athāpi manaso muni-puṅgavānām
so 'py asti yat-prapada-sīmny avicintya-tattve
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.34.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, only the tip of the toe of whose lotus feet is approached by the yogīs who aspire after the transcendental and betake themselves to prāṇāyāma by drilling the respiration.

BS 5.35.text:
eko 'py asau racayituṁ jagad-aṇḍa-koṭiṁ
yac-chaktir asti jagad-aṇḍa-cayā yad-antaḥ
aṇḍāntara-stha-paramāṇu-cayāntara-stham-
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.35.translation: He is an undifferentiated entity as there is no distinction between potency and the possessor thereof. In His work of creation of millions of worlds, His potency remains inseparable. Such is the primeval Lord whom I adore.

BS 5.36.text:
yad-bhāva-bhāvita-dhiyo manujās tathaiva
samprāpya rūpa-mahimāsana-yāna-bhūṣāḥ
sūktair yam eva nigama-prathitaiḥ stuvanti
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.36.translation: I adore the same Govinda, the primeval Lord, in whose praise men, who are imbued with devotion, sing the mantra-sūktas told by the Vedas, by gaining their appropriate beauty, greatness, thrones, conveyances and ornaments.

BS 5.37.text:
ānanda-cinmaya-rasa-pratibhāvitābhis
tābhir ya eva nija-rūpatayā kalābhiḥ
goloka eva nivasaty akhilātma-bhūto
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.37.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, residing in His own realm, Goloka, with Rādhā, resembling His own spiritual figure, the embodiment of the ecstatic potency possessed of the sixty-four artistic activities, in the company of Her confidantes, embodiments of the extensions of Her bodily form, permeated and vitalized by His ever-blissful spiritual rasa.

BS 5.38.text:
premāñjana-cchurita-bhakti-vilocanena
santaḥ sadaiva hṛdayeṣu vilokayanti
yaṁ śyāmasundaram acintya-guṇa-svarūpaṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.38.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, who is Śyāmasundara, Kṛṣṇa Himself with inconceivable innumerable attributes, whom the pure devotees see in their heart of hearts with the eye of devotion tinged with the salve of love.

BS 5.39.text:
rāmādi-mūrtiṣu kalā-niyamena tiṣṭhan
nānāvatāram akarod bhuvaneṣu kintu
kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṁ samabhavat paramaḥ pumān yo
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.39.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, who manifested Himself personally as Kṛṣṇa and the different avatāras in the world in the forms of Rāma, Nṛsiṁha, Vāmana, etc., as His subjective portions.

BS 5.40.text:
yasya prabhā prabhavato jagad-aṇḍa-koṭi-
koṭiṣv aśeṣa-vasudhādi vibhūti-bhinnam
tad brahma niṣkalam anantam aśeṣa-bhūtaṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.40.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, whose effulgence is the source of the nondifferentiated Brahman mentioned in the Upaniṣads, being differentiated from the infinity of glories of the mundane universe appears as the indivisible, infinite, limitless, truth.

BS 5.41.text:
māyā hi yasya jagad-aṇḍa-śatāni sūte
traiguṇya-tad-viṣaya-veda-vitāyamānā
sattvāvalambi-para-sattvaṁ viśuddha-sattvam-
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.41.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, who is the absolute substantive principle being the ultimate entity in the form of the support of all existence whose external potency embodies the threefold mundane qualities.

BS 5.42.text:
ānanda-cinmaya-rasātmatayā manaḥsu
yaḥ prāṇināṁ pratiphalan smaratām upetya
līlāyitena bhuvanāni jayaty ajasram-
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.42.translation: I worship Govinda, the primeval Lord, whose glory ever triumphantly dominates the mundane world by the activity of His own pastimes, being reflected in the mind of recollecting souls as the transcendental entity of ever-blissful cognitive rasa.

BS 5.44.text:
sṛṣṭi-sthiti-pralaya-sādhana-śaktir ekā
chāyeva yasya bhuvanāni bibharti durgā
icchānurūpam api yasya ca ceṣṭate sā
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.44.translation: The external potency Māyā who is of the nature of the shadow of the cit potency, is worshiped by all people as Durgā, the creating, preserving and destroying agency of this mundane world. I adore the primeval Lord Govinda in accordance with whose will Durgā conducts herself.

BS 5.45.text:
kṣīraṁ yathā dadhi vikāra-viśeṣa-yogāt
sañjāyate na hi tataḥ pṛthag asti hetoḥ
yaḥ śambhutām api tathā samupaiti kāryād
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.45.translation: Just as milk is transformed into curd by the action of acids, but yet the effect curd is neither same as, nor different from, its cause, viz., milk, so I adore the primeval Lord Govinda of whom the state of Śambhu is a transformation for the performance of the work of destruction.

BS 5.46.text:
dīpārcir eva hi daśāntaram abhyupetya
dīpāyate vivṛta-hetu-samāna-dharmā
yas tādṛg eva hi ca viṣṇutayā vibhāti
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.46.translation: The light of one candle being communicated to other candles, although it burns separately in them, is the same in its quality. I adore the primeval Lord Govinda who exhibits Himself equally in the same mobile manner in His various manifestations.

BS 5.47.text:
yaḥ kāraṇārṇava-jale bhajati sma yoga-
nidrām ananta-jagad-aṇḍa-sa-roma-kūpaḥ
ādhāra-śaktim avalambya parāṁ sva-mūrtiṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.47.translation: I adore the primeval Lord Govinda who assuming His own great subjective form, who bears the name of Śeṣa, replete with the all-accommodating potency, and reposing in the Causal Ocean with the infinity of the world in the pores of His hair, enjoys creative sleep.

BS 5.48.text:
yasyaika-niśvasita-kālam athāvalambya
jīvanti loma-vilajā jagad-aṇḍa-nāthāḥ
viṣṇur mahān sa iha yasya kalā-viśeṣo
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.48.translation: Brahmā and other lords of the mundane worlds, appearing from the pores of hair of Mahā-Viṣṇu, remain alive as long as the duration of one exhalation of the latter. I adore the primeval Lord Govinda of whose subjective personality Mahā-Viṣṇu is the portion of portion.

BS 5.49.text:
bhāsvān yathāśma-śakaleṣu nijeṣu tejaḥ
svīyam kiyat prakaṭayaty api tadvad atra
brahmā ya eṣa jagad-aṇḍa-vidhāna-kartā
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.49.translation: I adore the primeval Lord Govinda from whom the separated subjective portion Brahmā receives his power for the regulation of the mundane world, just as the sun manifests some portion of his own light in all the effulgent gems.

BS 5.50.text:
yat-pāda-pallava-yugaṁ vinidhāya kumbha-
dvandve praṇāma-samaye sa gaṇādhirājaḥ
vighnān vihantum alam asya jagat-trayasya
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.50.translation: I adore the primeval Lord Govinda, whose lotus feet are always held by Gaṇeśa upon the pair of tumuli protruding from his elephant head in order to obtain power for his function of destroying all the obstacles on the path of progress of the three worlds.

BS 5.51.text:
agnir mahi gaganam ambu marud diśaś ca
kālas tathātma-manasīti jagat-trayāṇi
yasmād bhavanti vibhavanti viśanti yaṁ ca
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.51.translation: The three worlds are composed of the nine elements, viz., fire, earth, ether, water, air, direction, time, soul and mind. I adore the primeval Lord Govinda from whom they originate, in whom they exist and into whom they enter at the time of the universal cataclysm.

BS 5.52.text:
yac-cakṣur eṣa savitā sakala-grahāṇāṁ
rājā samasta-sura-mūrtir aśeṣa-tejāḥ
yasyājñayā bhramati sambhṛta-kāla-cakro
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.52.translation: The sun who is the king of all the planets, full of infinite effulgence, the image of the good soul, is as the eye of this world. I adore the primeval Lord Govinda in pursuance of whose order the sun performs his journey mounting the wheel of time.

BS 5.53.text:
dharmo 'tha pāpa-nicayaḥ śrutayas tapāṁsi
brahmādi-kīṭa-patagāvadhayaś ca jīvāḥ
yad-datta-mātra-vibhava-prakaṭa-prabhāvā
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.53.translation: I adore the primeval Lord Govinda, by whose conferred power are maintained the manifested potencies, that are found to exist, of all virtues, all vices, the Vedas, the penances and all jīvas, from Brahmā to the meanest insect.

BS 5.54.text:
yas tv indragopam athavendram aho sva-karma-
bandhānurūpa-phala-bhājanam ātanoti
karmāṇi nirdahati kintu ca bhakti-bhājāṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.54.translation: I adore the primeval Lord Govinda, who burns up to their roots all fruitive activities of those who are imbued with devotion and impartially ordains for each the due enjoyment of the fruits of one's activities.

BS 5.55.text:
yaṁ krodha-kāma-sahaja-praṇayādi-bhīti-
vātsalya-moha-guru-gaurava-sevya-bhāvaiḥ
sañcintya tasya sadṛśīṁ tanum āpur ete
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
BS 5.55.translation: I adore the primeval Lord Govinda, the meditators of whom, by meditating upon Him under the sway of wrath, amorous passion, natural friendly love, fear, parental affection, delusion, reverence and willing service, attain to bodily forms befitting the nature of their contemplation.

BS 5.56.text:
śriyaḥ kāntāḥ kāntaḥ parama-puruṣaḥ kalpa-taravo
drumā bhūmiś cintāmaṇi-gaṇa-mayi toyam amṛtam
kathā gānaṁ nāṭyaṁ gamanam api vaṁśī priya-sakhi
cid-ānandaṁ jyotiḥ param api tad āsvādyam api ca
sa yatra kṣīrābdhiḥ sravati surabhībhyaś ca su-mahān
nimeṣārdhākhyo vā vrajati na hi yatrāpi samayaḥ
bhaje śvetadvīpaṁ tam aham iha golokam iti yaṁ
vidantas te santaḥ kṣiti-virala-cārāḥ katipaye
BS 5.56.translation: I worship that transcendental seat, known as Śvetadvīpa where as loving consorts the Lakṣmīs in their unalloyed spiritual essence practice the amorous service of the Supreme Lord Kṛṣṇa as their only lover.

BS 5.57.text:
athovāca mahā-viṣṇur
bhagavantaṁ prajāpatim
brahman mahattva-vijñāne
prajā-sarge ca cen matiḥ
pañca-ślokīm imāṁ vidyāṁ
vatsa dattāṁ nibodha me
BS 5.57.translation: On hearing these hymns containing the essence of the truth, the Supreme Lord Kṛṣṇa said to Brahmā, 'Brahmā, if you experience the inclination to create offspring by being endowed with the real knowledge of the glory of Godhead, listen, My beloved, from Me to this science set forth in the following five ślokas.'

BS 5.58.text:
prabuddhe jñāna-bhaktibhyām
ātmany ānanda-cin-mayī
udety anuttamā bhaktir
bhagavat-prema-lakṣaṇā
BS 5.58.translation: When the pure spiritual experience is excited by means of cognition and service, superexcellent unalloyed devotion characterized by love for Godhead is awakened towards Kṛṣṇa, the beloved of all souls.

BS 5.59.text:
pramāṇais tat-sad-ācārais
tad-abhyāsair nirantaram
bodhayan ātmanātmānaṁ
bhaktim apy uttamāṁ labhet
BS 5.59.translation: The highest devotion is attained by slow degrees by the method of constant endeavor for self-realization with the help of scriptural evidence, theistic conduct and perseverance in practice.

BS 5.60.text:
yasyāḥ śreyas-karaṁ nāsti
yayā nirvṛtim āpnuyāt
yā sādhayati mām eva
bhaktiṁ tām eva sādhayet
BS 5.60.translation: These preliminary practices of devotion are conducive to the realization of loving devotion — than whom there is no superior well-being, who goes hand in hand with the attainment of the exclusive state of supreme bliss and who can lead to Myself.

BS 5.61.text:
dharmān anyān parityajya
mām ekaṁ bhaja viśvasan
yādṛśī yādṛśī śraddhā
siddhir bhavati tādṛśī
kurvan nirantaraṁ karma
loko 'yam anuvartate
tenaiva karmaṇā dhyāyan
māṁ parāṁ bhaktim icchati
BS 5.61.translation: Abandoning all meritorious performances serve Me with faith. The realization will correspond to the nature of one's faith. The people of the world act ceaselessly in pursuance of some ideal.

BS 5.62.text:
ahaṁ hi viśvasya carācarasya
bījaṁ pradhānaṁ prakṛtiḥ pumāṁś ca
mayāhitaṁ teja idaṁ bibharṣi
vidhe vidhehi tvam atho jaganti
BS 5.62.translation: 'Listen, O Vidhi, I am the seed, i.e., the fundamental principle, of this world of animate and inanimate objects. I am pradhāna, I am prakṛti and I am puruṣa. This fiery energy that belongs specially to the Brahman, that inheres in you, has also been conferred by Me.'

BB 1.1.1.text:
jayati nija-padābja-prema-dānāvatīrṇo
vividha-madhurimābdhiḥ ko ’pi kaiśora-gandhiḥ
gata-parama-daśāntaṁ yasya caitanya-rūpād
anubhava-padam āptaṁ prema gopīṣu nityam
apīcya-darśanaṁ śaśvat
tathā parama-haṁsānāṁ
BB 1.1.1.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 1

BB 1.1.2.text:
śrī-rādhikā-prabhṛtayo nitarāṁ jayanti
gopyo nitānta-bhagavat-priyatā-prasiddhāḥ
yāsāṁ harau parama-sauhṛda-mādhurīṇāṁ
nirvaktum īṣad api jātu na ko ’pi śaktaḥ
na pāraye ’haṁ niravadya-saṁyujāṁ
BB 1.1.2.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 2

BB 1.1.3.text:
sva-dayita-nija-bhāvaṁ yo vibhāvya sva-bhāvāt
su-madhuram avatīrṇo bhakta-rūpeṇa lobhāt
jayati kanaka-dhāmā kṛṣṇa-caitanya-nāmā
harir iha yati-veśaḥ śrī-śacī-sūnur eṣaḥ
nirapekṣaṁ muniṁ śāntaṁ
kālān naṣṭaṁ bhakti-yogaṁ nijaṁ yaḥ
BB 1.1.3.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 3

BB 1.1.4.text:
jayati mathurā-devī śreṣṭhā purīṣu mano-ramā
parama-dayitā kaṁsārāter jani-sthiti-rañjitā
durita-haraṇān mukter bhakter api pratipādanāj
jagati mahitā tat-tat-krīḍā-kathāstu vidūrataḥ
tri-varga-dā kāmināṁ yā
anyatra yat kṛtaṁ pāpaṁ
mathurāyāṁ kṛtaṁ pāpaṁ
jñānato ’jñānato vāpi
kāśy-ādi-puryo yadi nāma santi
anyeṣu puṇya-kṣetreṣu
BB 1.1.4.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 4

BB 1.1.5.text:
jayati jayati vṛndāraṇyam etan murāreḥ
priya-tamam ati-sādhu-svānta-vaikuṇṭha-vāsāt
ramayati sa sadā gāḥ pālayan yatra gopīḥ
svarita-madhura-veṇur vardhayan prema rāse
vṛndāvanaṁ govardhanaṁ
puṇyā bata vraja-bhuvo yad ayaṁ nṛ-liṅga-
BB 1.1.5.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 5

BB 1.1.6.text:
jayati taraṇi-putrī dharma-rāja-svasā yā
kalayati mathurāyāḥ sakhyam atyeti gaṅgām
mura-hara-dayitā tat-pāda-padma-prasūtaṁ
vahati ca makarandaṁ nīra-pūra-cchalena
gaṅgā śata-guṇā proktā
tasyāḥ śata-guṇā proktā
BB 1.1.6.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 6

BB 1.1.7.text:
govardhano jayati śaila-kulādhirājo
yo gopikābhir udito hari-dāsa-varyaḥ
kṛṣṇena śakra-makha-bhaṅga-kṛtārcito yaḥ
saptāham asya kara-padma-tale ’py avātsīt
hantāyam adrir abalā hari-dāsa-varyo
BB 1.1.7.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 7

BB 1.1.8.text:
jayati jayati kṛṣṇa-prema-bhaktir yad-aṅghriṁ
nikhila-nigama-tattvaṁ gūḍham ājñāya muktiḥ
bhajati śaraṇa-kāmā vaiṣṇavais tyajyamānā
japa-yajana-tapasyā-nyāsa-niṣṭhāṁ vihāya
BB 1.1.8.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 8

BB 1.1.9.text:
jayati jayati nāmānanda-rūpaṁ murārer
viramita-nija-dharma-dhyāna-pūjādi-yatnam
katham api sakṛd āttaṁ mukti-daṁ prāṇināṁ yat
paramam amṛtam ekaṁ jīvanaṁ bhūṣaṇaṁ me
aho bata śva-paco ’to garīyān
dhyāyan kṛte yajan yajñais
etāvatālam agha-nirharaṇāya puṁsāṁ
citraṁ vidūra-vigataḥ sakṛd ādadīta
yan-nāma-sakṛc-chravaṇāt
madhura-madhuram etan maṅgalaṁ maṅgalānāṁ
BB 1.1.9.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 9

BB 1.1.10.text:
namaḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-candrāya
nirupādhi-kṛpā-kṛte
yaḥ śrī-caitanya-rūpo ’bhūt
tanvan prema-rasaṁ kalau
BB 1.1.10.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 10

BB 1.1.11.text:
bhagavad-bhakti-śāstrāṇām
ayaṁ sārasya saṅgrahaḥ
anubhūtasya caitanya-
deve tat-priya-rūpataḥ
BB 1.1.11.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 11

BB 1.1.12.text:
śṛṇvantu vaiṣṇavāḥ śāstram
idaṁ bhāgavatāmṛtam
su-gopyaṁ prāha yat premṇā
jaiminir janamejayam
sāṅgaṁ sa-mudraṁ sa-nyāsaṁ
aṣṭākṣaram athānyaṁ vā
BB 1.1.12.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 12

BB 1.1.13.text:
munīndrāj jaimineḥ śrutvā
bhāratākhyānam adbhutam
parīkṣin-nandano ’pṛcchat
tat-khilaṁ śravaṇotsukaḥ
BB 1.1.13.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 13

BB 1.1.14.text:
śrī-janamejaya uvāca
na vaiśampāyanāt prāpto
brahman yo bhārate rasaḥ
tvatto labdhaḥ sa tac-cheṣaṁ
madhureṇa samāpaya
BB 1.1.14.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 14

BB 1.1.15-17.text:
śrī-jaiminir uvāca
śuka-devopadeśena
nihatāśeṣa-sādhvasam
samyak-prāpta-samastārthaṁ
śrī-kṛṣṇa-prema-samplutam
sannikṛṣṭa-nijābhīṣṭa-
padārohaṇa-kālakam
śrīmat-parīkṣitaṁ mātā
tasyārtā kṛṣṇa-tatparā
virāṭa-tanayaikānte
’pṛcchad etan nṛpottamam
prabodhyānanditā tena
putreṇa sneha-samplutā
BB 1.1.15-17.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 15-17

BB 1.1.18.text:
śrī-uttarovāca
yac chukenopadiṣṭaṁ te
vatsa niṣkṛṣya tasya me
sāraṁ prakāśaya kṣipraṁ
kṣīrāmbhodher ivāmṛtam
BB 1.1.18.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 18

BB 1.1.19.text:
śrī-jaiminir uvāca
uvāca sādaraṁ rājā
parīkṣin mātṛ-vatsalaḥ
śrutāty-adbhuta-govinda-
kathākhyāna-rasotsukaḥ
BB 1.1.19.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 19

BB 1.1.20.text:
śrī-viṣṇurāta uvāca
mātar yady api kāle ’smiṁś
cikīrṣita-muni-vrataḥ
tathāpy ahaṁ tava praśna-
mādhurī-mukharī-kṛtaḥ
BB 1.1.20.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 20

BB 1.1.21-23.text:
guroḥ prasādatas tasya
śrīmato bādarāyaṇeḥ
praṇamya te sa-putrāyāḥ
prāṇa-daṁ prabhum acyutam
tat-kāruṇya-prabhāveṇa
śrīmad-bhāgavatāmṛtam
samuddhṛtaṁ prayatnena
śrīmad-bhāgavatottamaiḥ
munīndra-maṇḍalī-madhye
niścitaṁ mahatāṁ matam
mahā-guhya-mayaṁ samyak
kathayāmy avadhāraya
nigama-kalpataror galitaṁ phalaṁ
BB 1.1.21-23.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 21-23

BB 1.1.24-25.text:
ekadā tīrtha-mūrdhanye
prayāge muni-puṅgavāḥ
māghe prātaḥ kṛta-snānāḥ
śrī-mādhava-samīpataḥ
upaviṣṭā mudāviṣṭā
manyamānāḥ kṛtārthatām
kṛṣṇasya dayito ’sīti
ślāghante sma parasparam
vrata-dāna-tapobhiś ca
BB 1.1.24-25.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 24-25

BB 1.1.26.text:
mātas tadānīṁ tatraiva
vipra-varyaḥ samāgataḥ
daśāśvamedhike tīrthe
bhagavad-bhakti-tatparaḥ
BB 1.1.26.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 26

BB 1.1.27.text:
sevito ’śeṣa-sampadbhis
tad-deśasyādhikāra-vān
vṛtaḥ parijanair vipra-
bhojanārthaṁ kṛtodyamaḥ
BB 1.1.27.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 27

BB 1.1.28.text:
vicitrotkṛṣṭa-vastūni
sa niṣpādya mahā-manāḥ
āvaśyakaṁ samāpyādau
saṁskṛtya mahatīṁ sthalīm
BB 1.1.28.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 28

BB 1.1.29.text:
satvaraṁ catvaraṁ tatra
madhye nirmāya sundaram
upalipya sva-hastena
vitānāny udatānayat
BB 1.1.29.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 29

BB 1.1.30.text:
śālagrāma-śilā-rūpaṁ
kṛṣṇaṁ svarṇāsane śubhe
niveśya bhaktyā sampūjya
yathā-vidhi mudā bhṛtaḥ
BB 1.1.30.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 30

BB 1.1.31.text:
bhogāmbarādi-sāmagrīm
arpayitvāgrato hareḥ
svayaṁ nṛtyan gīta-vādyā-
dibhiś cakre mahotsavam
BB 1.1.31.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 31

BB 1.1.32.text:
tato veda-purāṇādi-
vyākhyābhir vāda-kovidān
viprān praṇamya yatino
gṛhiṇo brahma-cāriṇaḥ
BB 1.1.32.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 32

BB 1.1.33.text:
vaiṣṇavāṁś ca sadā kṛṣṇa-
kīrtanānanda-lampaṭān
su-bahūn madhurair vākyair
vyavahāraiś ca harṣayan
BB 1.1.33.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 33

BB 1.1.34.text:
pāda-śauca-jalaṁ teṣāṁ
dhārayan śirasi svayam
bhagavaty arpitais tadvad
annādibhir apūjayat
BB 1.1.34.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 34

BB 1.1.35.text:
bhojayitvā tato dīnān
antyajān api sādaram
atoṣayad yathā-nyāyaṁ
śva-śṛgāla-khaga-krimīn
BB 1.1.35.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 35

BB 1.1.36.text:
evaṁ santarpitāśeṣaḥ
samādiṣṭo ’tha sādhubhiḥ
parivāraiḥ samaṁ śeṣaṁ
sa-harṣaṁ bubhuje ’mṛtam
BB 1.1.36.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 36

BB 1.1.37.text:
tato ’bhimukham āgatya
kṛṣṇasya racitāñjaliḥ
tasminn evārpayām āsa
sarvaṁ tat-phala-sañcayam
BB 1.1.37.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 37

BB 1.1.38.text:
sukhaṁ saṁveśya devaṁ taṁ
sva-gṛhaṁ gantum udyatam
dūrāc chrī-nārado dṛṣṭvo-
tthito muni-samājataḥ
BB 1.1.38.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 38

BB 1.1.39-40.text:
ayam eva mahā-viṣṇoḥ
preyān iti muhur bruvan
dhāvan gatvāntike tasya
viprendrasyedam abravīt
śrī-kṛṣṇa-paramotkṛṣṭa-
kṛpāyā bhājanaṁ janam
loke vikhyāpayan vyaktaṁ
bhagavad-bhakti-lampaṭaḥ
BB 1.1.39-40.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 39-40

BB 1.1.41.text:
śrī-nārada uvāca
bhavān viprendra kṛṣṇasya
mahānugraha-bhājanam
yasyedṛśaṁ dhanaṁ dravyam
audāryaṁ vaibhavaṁ tathā
BB 1.1.41.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 41

BB 1.1.42.text:
sad-dharmāpādakaṁ tac ca
sarvam eva mahā-mate
dṛṣṭaṁ hi sākṣād asmābhir
asmiṁs tīrtha-vare ’dhunā
BB 1.1.42.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 42

BB 1.1.43.text:
vidvad-vareṇa tenokto
nanv idaṁ sa mahā-muniḥ
svāmin kiṁ mayi kṛṣṇasya
kṛpā-lakṣaṇam īkṣitam
BB 1.1.43.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 43

BB 1.1.44.text:
ahaṁ varākaḥ ko nu syāṁ
dātuṁ śaknomi vā kiyat
vaibhavaṁ vartate kiṁ me
bhagavad-bhajanaṁ kutaḥ
BB 1.1.44.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 44

BB 1.1.45.text:
kintu dakṣiṇa-deśe yo
mahā-rājo virājate
sa hi kṛṣṇa-kṛpā-pātraṁ
yasya deśe surālayāḥ
BB 1.1.45.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 45

BB 1.1.46.text:
sarvato bhikṣavo yatra
tairthikābhyāgatādayaḥ
kṛṣṇārpitānnaṁ bhuñjānā
bhramanti sukhinaḥ sadā
BB 1.1.46.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 46

BB 1.1.47.text:
rājadhānī-samīpe ca
sac-cid-ānanda-vigrahaḥ
sākṣād ivāste bhagavān
kāruṇyāt sthiratāṁ gataḥ
BB 1.1.47.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 47

BB 1.1.48.text:
nityaṁ nava-navas tatra
jāyate paramotsavaḥ
pūjā-dravyāṇi ceṣṭāni
nūtanāni prati-kṣaṇam
BB 1.1.48.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 48

BB 1.1.49.text:
viṣṇor niveditais tais tu
sarve tad-deśa-vāsinaḥ
vaideśikāś ca bahavo
bhojyante tena sādaram
BB 1.1.49.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 49

BB 1.1.50-51.text:
puṇḍarīkākṣa-devasya
tasya darśana-lobhataḥ
mahā-prasāda-rūpānnādy-
upabhoga-sukhāptitaḥ
sādhu-saṅgati-lābhāc ca
nānā-deśāt samāgatāḥ
nivasanti sadā tatra
santo viṣṇu-parāyaṇāḥ
BB 1.1.50-51.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 50-51

BB 1.1.52.text:
deśaś ca deva-viprebhyo
rājñā datto vibhajya saḥ
nopadravo ’sti tad-deśe
ko ’pi śoko ’tha vā bhayam
BB 1.1.52.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 52

BB 1.1.53.text:
akṛṣṭa-pacyā sā bhūmir
vṛṣṭis tatra yathā-sukham
iṣṭāni phala-mūlāni
su-labhāny ambarāṇi ca
BB 1.1.53.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 53

BB 1.1.54.text:
sva-sva-dharma-kṛtaḥ sarvāḥ
sukhinyaḥ kṛṣṇa-tatparāḥ
prajās tam anuvartante
mahā-rājaṁ yathā sutāḥ
BB 1.1.54.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 54

BB 1.1.55.text:
sa cāgarvaḥ sadā nīca-
yogya-sevābhir acyutam
bhajamāno ’khilān lokān
ramayaty acyuta-priyaḥ
BB 1.1.55.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 55

BB 1.1.56-57.text:
tasyāgre vividhair nāma-
gāthā-saṅkīrtanaiḥ svayam
nṛtyan divyāni gītāni
gāyan vādyāni vādayan
bhrātṛ-bhāryā-sutaiḥ pautrair
bhṛtyāmātya-purohitaiḥ
anyaiś ca sva-janaiḥ sākaṁ
prabhuṁ taṁ toṣayet sadā
BB 1.1.56-57.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 56-57

BB 1.1.58.text:
te te tasya guṇa-vrātāḥ
kṛṣṇa-bhakty-anuvartinaḥ
saṅkhyātuṁ kati kathyante
jñāyante kati vā mayā
BB 1.1.58.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 58

BB 1.1.59.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
tato nṛpa-varaṁ draṣṭuṁ
tad-deśe nārado vrajan
deva-pūjotsavāsaktās
tatra tatraikṣata prajāḥ
BB 1.1.59.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 59

BB 1.1.60.text:
harṣeṇa vādayan vīṇāṁ
rājadhānīṁ gato ’dhikam
viproktād api sampaśyan
saṅgamyovāca taṁ nṛpam
BB 1.1.60.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 60

BB 1.1.61.text:
śrī-nārada uvāca
tvaṁ śrī-kṛṣṇa-kṛpā-pātraṁ
yasyedṛg rājya-vaibhavam
sal-loka-guṇa-dharmārtha-
jñāna-bhaktibhir anvitam
BB 1.1.61.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 61

BB 1.1.62.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
tat tad vistārya kathayann
āśliṣyan bhūpatiṁ muhuḥ
praśaśaṁsa guṇān gāyan
vīṇayā vaiṣṇavottamaḥ
BB 1.1.62.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 62

BB 1.1.63.text:
sārvabhaumo muni-varaṁ
sampūjya praśrito ’bravīt
nija-ślāghā-bharāj jāta-
lajjā-namita-mastakaḥ
BB 1.1.63.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 63

BB 1.1.64-65.text:
devarṣe ’lpāyuṣaṁ svalpai-
śvaryam alpa-pradaṁ naram
asvatantraṁ bhayākrāntaṁ
tāpa-traya-niyantritam
kṛṣṇānugraha-vākyasyāpy
ayogyam avicārataḥ
tadīya-karuṇā-pātraṁ
kathaṁ māṁ manyate bhavān
BB 1.1.64-65.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 64-65

BB 1.1.66.text:
devā eva dayā-pātraṁ
viṣṇor bhagavataḥ kila
pūjyamānā narair nityaṁ
tejo-maya-śarīriṇaḥ
BB 1.1.66.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 66

BB 1.1.67.text:
niṣpāpāḥ sāttvikā duḥkha-
rahitāḥ sukhinaḥ sadā
svacchandācāra-gatayo
bhaktecchā-vara-dāyakāḥ
BB 1.1.67.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 67

BB 1.1.68.text:
yeṣāṁ hi bhogyam amṛtaṁ
mṛtyu-roga-jarādi-hṛt
svecchayopanataṁ kṣut-tṛḍ-
bādhābhāve ’pi tuṣṭi-dam
BB 1.1.68.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 68

BB 1.1.69.text:
vasanti bhagavan svarge
mahā-bhāgya-balena ye
yo nṛbhir bhārate varṣe
sat-puṇyair labhyate kṛtaiḥ
BB 1.1.69.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 69

BB 1.1.70.text:
mune viśiṣṭas tatrāpi
teṣām indraḥ purandaraḥ
nigrahe ’nugrahe ’pīśo
vṛṣṭibhir loka-jīvanaḥ
BB 1.1.70.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 70

BB 1.1.71.text:
tri-lokīśvaratā yasya
yugānām eka-saptatim
yāśvamedha-śatenāpi
sārvabhaumasya durlabhā
BB 1.1.71.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 71

BB 1.1.72.text:
haya uccaiḥśravā yasya
gaja airāvato mahān
kāma-dhug gaur upavanaṁ
nandanaṁ ca virājate
BB 1.1.72.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 72

BB 1.1.73.text:
pārijātādayo yatra
vartante kāma-pūrakāḥ
kāma-rūpa-dharāḥ kalpa-
drumāḥ kalpa-latānvitāḥ
BB 1.1.73.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 73

BB 1.1.74.text:
yeṣām ekena puṣpeṇa
yathā-kāmaṁ su-sidhyati
vicitra-gīta-vāditra-
nṛtya-veśāśanādikam
BB 1.1.74.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 74

BB 1.1.75.text:
āḥ kiṁ vācyaṁ paraṁ tasya
saubhāgyaṁ bhagavān gataḥ
kaniṣṭha-bhrātṛtāṁ yasya
viṣṇur vāmana-rūpa-dhṛk
BB 1.1.75.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 75

BB 1.1.76.text:
āpadbhyo yam asau rakṣan
harṣayan yena vistṛtām
sākṣāt svī-kurute pūjāṁ
tad vetsi tvam utāparam
BB 1.1.76.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 76

BB 1.2.1.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
praśasya taṁ mahā-rājaṁ
svar-gato munir aikṣata
rājamānaṁ sabhā-madhye
viṣṇuṁ deva-gaṇair vṛtam
BB 1.2.1.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 1

BB 1.2.2.text:
vicitra-kalpa-druma-puṣpa-mālā-
vilepa-bhūṣā-vasanāmṛtādyaiḥ
samarcitaṁ divyataropacāraiḥ
sukhopaviṣṭaṁ garuḍasya pṛṣṭhe
BB 1.2.2.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 2

BB 1.2.3.text:
bṛhaspati-prabhṛtibhiḥ
stūyamānaṁ maharṣibhiḥ
lālyamānam adityā tān
harṣayantaṁ priyoktibhiḥ
BB 1.2.3.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 3

BB 1.2.4.text:
siddha-vidyādhra-gandharvā-
psarobhir vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ
jaya-śabdair vādya-gīta-
nṛtyaiś ca paritoṣitam
BB 1.2.4.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 4

BB 1.2.5.text:
śakrāyābhayam uccoktyā
daityebhyo dadataṁ dṛḍham
kīrtyārpyamāṇaṁ tāmbūlaṁ
carvantaṁ līlayāhṛtam
BB 1.2.5.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 5

BB 1.2.6.text:
śakraṁ ca tasya māhātmyaṁ
kīrtayantaṁ muhur muhuḥ
svasmin kṛtopakārāṁś ca
varṇayantaṁ mahā-mudā
BB 1.2.6.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 6

BB 1.2.7.text:
sahasra-nayanair aśru-
dhārā varṣantam āsane
svīye niṣaṇṇaṁ tat-pārśve
rājantaṁ sva-vibhūtibhiḥ
BB 1.2.7.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 7

BB 1.2.8.text:
atha viṣṇuṁ nijāvāse
gacchantam anugamya tam
sabhāyām āgataṁ śakram
āśasyovāca nāradaḥ
BB 1.2.8.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 8

BB 1.2.9.text:
śrī-nārada uvāca
kṛtānukampitas tvaṁ yat
sūrya-candra-yamādayaḥ
tavājñā-kāriṇaḥ sarve
loka-pālāḥ pare kim u
BB 1.2.9.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 9

BB 1.2.10.text:
munayo ’smādṛśo vaśyāḥ
śrutayas tvāṁ stuvanti hi
jagad-īśatayā yat tvaṁ
dharmādharma-phala-pradaḥ
BB 1.2.10.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 10

BB 1.2.11.text:
aho nārāyaṇo bhrātā
kanīyān yasya sodaraḥ
sad-dharmaṁ mānayan yasya
vidadhāty ādaraṁ sadā
BB 1.2.11.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 11

BB 1.2.12.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
ittham indrasya saubhāgya-
vaibhavaṁ kīrtayan muhuḥ
devarṣir vādayan vīṇāṁ
ślāghamāno nanarta tam
BB 1.2.12.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 12

BB 1.2.13.text:
tato ’bhivādya devarṣim
uvācendraḥ śanair hriyā
bho gāndharva-kalābhijña
kiṁ mām upahasann asi
BB 1.2.13.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 13

BB 1.2.14.text:
asya na svarga-rājyasya
vṛttaṁ vetsi tvam eva kim
kati vārān ito daitya-
bhītyāsmābhir na nirgatam
BB 1.2.14.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 14

BB 1.2.15.text:
ācaran balir indratvam
asurān eva sarvataḥ
sūryendv-ādy-adhikāreṣu
nyayuṅkta kratu-bhāga-bhuk
BB 1.2.15.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 15

BB 1.2.16.text:
tato nas tāta-mātṛbhyāṁ
tapobhir vitatair dṛḍhaiḥ
toṣito ’py aṁśa-mātreṇa
gato bhrātṛtvam acyutaḥ
BB 1.2.16.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 16

BB 1.2.17.text:
tathāpy ahatvā tāñ chatrūn
kevalaṁ nas trapā kṛtā
māyā-yācanayādāya
bale rājyaṁ dadau sa me
BB 1.2.17.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 17

BB 1.2.18.text:
spardhāsūyādi-doṣeṇa
brahma-hatyādi-pāpataḥ
nitya-pāta-bhayenāpi
kiṁ sukhaṁ svarga-vāsinām
ko nv arthaḥ sukhay
BB 1.2.18.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 18

BB 1.2.19.text:
kiṁ ca māṁ praty upendrasya
viddhy upekṣāṁ viśeṣataḥ
sudharmāṁ pārijātaṁ ca
svargān martyaṁ nināya saḥ
BB 1.2.19.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 19

BB 1.2.20.text:
gopālaiḥ kriyamāṇāṁ me
nyahan pūjāṁ cirantanīm
akhaṇḍaṁ khāṇḍavākhyaṁ me
priyaṁ dāhitavān vanam
BB 1.2.20.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 20

BB 1.2.21.text:
trai-lokya-grāsa-kṛd-vṛtra-
vadhārthaṁ prārthitaḥ purā
audāsīnyaṁ bhajaṁs tatra
prerayām āsa māṁ param
BB 1.2.21.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 21

BB 1.2.22.text:
utsādya mām avajñāya
madīyām amarāvatīm
sarvopari sva-bhavanaṁ
racayām āsa nūtanam
patnī vikuṇṭhā śubhrasya
vaikuṇṭhaḥ kalpito yena
idaṁ bhaṅktvā madīyaṁ ca
BB 1.2.22.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 22

BB 1.2.23.text:
ārādhana-balāt pitror
āgrahāc ca purodhasaḥ
pūjāṁ svī-kṛtya naḥ sadyo
yāty adṛśyaṁ nijaṁ padam
BB 1.2.23.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 23

BB 1.2.24-25.text:
punaḥ satvaram āgatya
svārghya-svī-karaṇād vayam
anugrāhyās tvayety ukto
’smān ādiśati vañcayan
yāvan nāhaṁ samāyāmi
tāvad brahmā śivo ’tha vā
bhavadbhiḥ pūjanīyo ’tra
matto bhinnau na tau yataḥ
BB 1.2.24-25.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 24-25

BB 1.2.26.text:
eka-mūrtis trayo devā
rudra-viṣṇu-pitāmahāḥ
ity-ādi-śāstra-vacanaṁ
bhavadbhir vismṛtaṁ kim u
BB 1.2.26.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 26

BB 1.2.27.text:
vāso ’syāniyato ’smābhir
agamyo muni-durlabhaḥ
vaikuṇṭhe dhruva-loke ca
kṣīrābdhau ca kadācana
BB 1.2.27.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 27

BB 1.2.28.text:
samprati dvārakāyāṁ ca
tatrāpi niyamo ’sti na
kadācit pāṇḍavāgāre
mathurāyāṁ kadācana
BB 1.2.28.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 28

BB 1.2.29.text:
puryāṁ kadācit tatrāpi
gokule ca vanād vane
itthaṁ tasyāvaloko ’pi
durlabho naḥ kutaḥ kṛpā
yarhy ambujākṣāpasasāra bho bhavān
BB 1.2.29.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 29

BB 1.2.30.text:
parameṣṭhi-suta-śreṣṭha
kintu sva-pitaraṁ hareḥ
anugraha-padaṁ viddhi
lakṣmī-kānta-suto hi saḥ
BB 1.2.30.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 30

BB 1.2.31.text:
yasyaikasmin dine śakrā
mādṛśāḥ syuś caturdaśa
manv-ādi-yuktā yasyāś ca
catur-yuga-sahasrakam
BB 1.2.31.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 31

BB 1.2.32.text:
niśā ca tāvatītthaṁ yā-
ho-rātrāṇāṁ śata-trayī
ṣaṣṭy-uttarā bhaved varṣaṁ
yasyāyus tac-chataṁ śrutam
manv-antaraṁ manur devā
BB 1.2.32.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 32

BB 1.2.33.text:
lokānāṁ loka-pālānām
api sraṣṭādhikāra-daḥ
pālakaḥ karma-phala-do
rātrau saṁhārakaś ca saḥ
BB 1.2.33.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 33

BB 1.2.34.text:
sahasra-śīrṣā yal-loke
sa mahā-puruṣaḥ sphuṭam
bhuñjāno yajña-bhāgaughaṁ
vasaty ānanda-daḥ sadā
kalpānte kāla-sṛṣṭena
ātmanā tri-vṛtā cedaṁ
ādyo ’vatāraḥ puruṣaḥ parasya
jagṛhe pauruṣaṁ rūpaṁ
yasyāmbhasi śayānasya
yasyāvayava-saṁsthānaiḥ
paśyanty ado rūpam adabhra-cakṣuṣā
etan nānāvatārāṇāṁ
tad vilokya viyad-vyāpi
padma-kośaṁ tadāviśya
bhūtair yadā pañcabhir ātma-sṛṣṭaiḥ
yat-kāya eṣa bhuvana-traya-sanniveśo
BB 1.2.34.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 34

BB 1.2.35.text:
itthaṁ yukti-sahasraiḥ sa
śrī-kṛṣṇasya kṛpāspadam
kiṁ vaktavyaṁ kṛpā-pātram
iti kṛṣṇaḥ sa eva hi
BB 1.2.35.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 35

BB 1.2.36.text:
tac chruti-smṛti-vākyebhyaḥ
prasiddhaṁ jñāyate tvayā
anyac ca tasya māhātmyaṁ
tal-lokānām api prabho
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
ātma-māyāṁ samāviśya
trayāṇām eka-bhāvānāṁ
BB 1.2.36.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 36

BB 1.2.37.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
indrasya vacanaṁ śrutvā
sādhu bhoḥ sādhv iti bruvan
tvarāvān brahmaṇo lokaṁ
bhagavān nārado gataḥ
BB 1.2.37.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 37

BB 1.2.38.text:
yajñānāṁ mahatāṁ tatra
brahmarṣibhir anāratam
bhaktyā vitāyamānānāṁ
praghoṣaṁ dūrato ’śṛṇot
BB 1.2.38.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 38

BB 1.2.39.text:
dadarśa ca tatas teṣu
prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ
mahā-puruṣa-rūpeṇa
jaṭā-maṇḍala-maṇḍitaḥ
BB 1.2.39.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 39

BB 1.2.40.text:
sahasra-mūrdhā bhagavān
yajña-mūrtiḥ śriyā saha
āvirbhūyādadad bhāgān
ānandayati yājakān
BB 1.2.40.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 40

BB 1.2.41.text:
padma-yoneḥ praharṣārthaṁ
dravya-jātaṁ niveditam
sahasra-pāṇibhir vaktra-
sahasreṣv arpayann adan
BB 1.2.41.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 41

BB 1.2.42.text:
dattveṣṭān yajamānebhyo
varān nidrā-gṛhaṁ gataḥ
lakṣmī-saṁvāhyamānāṅghrir
nidrām ādatta līlayā
sa dadarśa makheṣv ājyair
sa tatra praviśann eva
BB 1.2.42.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 42

BB 1.2.44-45.text:
pārameṣṭhyāsane tatra
sukhāsīnaṁ nija-prabhoḥ
mahima-śravaṇākhyāna-
paraṁ sāsrāṣṭa-netrakam
vicitra-paramaiśvarya-
sāmagrī-parisevitam
sva-tātaṁ nārado ’bhyetya
praṇamyovāca daṇḍa-vat
BB 1.2.44-45.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 44-45

BB 1.2.46.text:
śrī-nārada uvāca
bhavān eva kṛpā-pātraṁ
dhruvaṁ bhagavato hareḥ
prajāpati-patir yo vai
sarva-loka-pitāmahaḥ
BB 1.2.46.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 46

BB 1.2.47.text:
ekaḥ sṛjati pāty atti
bhuvanāni caturdaśa
brahmāṇḍasyeśvaro nityaṁ
svayam-bhūr yaś ca kathyate
BB 1.2.47.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 47

BB 1.2.48.text:
sabhāyāṁ yasya vidyante
mūrtimanto ’rtha-bodhakāḥ
yac-catur-vaktrato jātāḥ
purāṇa-nigamādayaḥ
BB 1.2.48.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 48

BB 1.2.49.text:
yasya lokaś ca niśchidra-
sva-dharmācāra-niṣṭhayā
madādi-rahitaiḥ sadbhir
labhyate śata-janmabhiḥ
BB 1.2.49.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 49

BB 1.2.50.text:
yasyopari na varteta
brahmāṇḍe bhuvanaṁ param
loko nārāyaṇasyāpi
vaikuṇṭhākhyo yad-antare
BB 1.2.50.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 50

BB 1.2.53.text:
tat satyam asi kṛṣṇasya
tvam eva nitarāṁ priyaḥ
aho nūnaṁ sa eva tvaṁ
līlā-nānā-vapur-dharaḥ
BB 1.2.53.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 53

BB 1.2.69.text:
śrīman-nṛsiṁha-rūpeṇa
prabhuṇā saṁhṛto yadā
tadāhaṁ sa-parivāro
vicitra-stava-pāṭavaiḥ
stuvan sthitvā bhayād dūre
’pāṅga-dṛṣṭyāpi nādṛtaḥ
prahlādasyābhiṣeke tu
vṛtte tasmin prasādataḥ
BB 1.2.69.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 69

BB 1.2.77.text:
tato vīkṣya mahāścaryaṁ
bhītaḥ stutvā namann api
dhṛṣṭo ’haṁ vañcitas tena
gopa-bālaka-līlayā
BB 1.2.77.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 77

BB 1.2.78.text:
tasya svābhāvikāsyābja-
prasādekṣaṇa-mātrataḥ
hṛṣṭaḥ svaṁ bahu manye sma
tat-priya-vraja-bhū-gateḥ
BB 1.2.78.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 78

BB 1.2.79.text:
tatrātmanaś cira-sthityā-
parādhāḥ syur iti trasan
apāsaraṁ kim anyais tan
nijāsaubhāgya-varṇanaiḥ
BB 1.2.79.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 79

BB 1.2.80.text:
atha brahmāṇḍa-madhye ’smin
tādṛṅ nekṣe kṛpāspadam
viṣṇoḥ kintu mahādeva
eva khyātaḥ sakheti yaḥ
BB 1.2.80.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 80

BB 1.2.81.text:
yaś ca śrī-kṛṣṇa-pādābja-
rasenonmāditaḥ sadā
avadhīrita-sarvārtha-
paramaiśvarya-bhogakaḥ
BB 1.2.81.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 81

BB 1.2.82.text:
asmādṛśo viṣayiṇo
bhogāsaktān hasann iva
dhustūrārkāsthi-mālā-dhṛg
nagno bhasmānulepanaḥ
BB 1.2.82.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 82

BB 1.2.83.text:
viprakīrṇa-jaṭā-bhāra
unmatta iva ghūrṇate
tathā sva-gopanāśaktaḥ
kṛṣṇa-pādābja-śauca-jām
gaṅgāṁ mūrdhni vahan harṣān
nṛtyaṁś ca layate jagat
BB 1.2.83.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 83

BB 1.2.84.text:
kṛṣṇa-prasādāt tenaiva
mādṛśām adhikāriṇām
abhīṣṭārpayituṁ muktis
tasya patnyāpi śakyate
BB 1.2.84.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 84

BB 1.2.85.text:
aho sarve ’pi te muktāḥ
śiva-loka-nivāsinaḥ
muktās tat-kṛpayā kṛṣṇa-
bhaktāś ca kati nābhavan
BB 1.2.85.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 85

BB 1.2.86.text:
kṛṣṇāc chivasya bhedekṣā
mahā-doṣa-karī matā
āgo bhagavatā svasmin
kṣamyate na śive kṛtam
śivasya śrī-viṣṇor ya iha guṇa-nāmādi sakalaṁ
BB 1.2.86.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 86

BB 1.2.89-90.text:
tiṣṭhatāpi svayaṁ sākṣāt
kṛṣṇenāmṛta-manthane
prajāpatibhir ārādhya
sa gaurī-prāṇa-vallabhaḥ
samānāyya viṣaṁ ghoraṁ
pāyayitvā vibhūṣitaḥ
mahā-mahima-dhārābhir
abhiṣiktaś ca tat sphuṭam
BB 1.2.89-90.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 89-90

BB 1.2.92.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
guruṁ praṇamya taṁ gantuṁ
kailāsaṁ girim utsukaḥ
ālakṣyoktaḥ punas tena
sva-putraḥ putra-vatsale
BB 1.2.92.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 92

BB 1.2.93.text:
śrī-brahmovāca
kuvereṇa purārādhya
bhaktyā rudro vaśī-kṛtaḥ
brahmāṇḍābhyantare tasya
kailāse ’dhikṛte girau
BB 1.2.93.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 93

BB 1.2.94.text:
tad-vidik-pāla-rūpeṇa
tad-yogya-parivārakaḥ
vasaty āviṣkṛta-svalpa-
vaibhavaḥ sann umā-patiḥ
BB 1.2.94.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 94

BB 1.2.95.text:
yathā hi kṛṣṇo bhagavān
mādṛśāṁ bhakti-yantritaḥ
mama loke svar-ādau ca
vasaty ucita-līlayā
BB 1.2.95.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 95

BB 1.2.96.text:
atha vāyu-purāṇasya
matam etad bravīmy aham
śrī-mahādeva-lokas tu
saptāvaraṇato bahiḥ
BB 1.2.96.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 96

BB 1.2.97-98.text:
nityaḥ sukha-mayaḥ satyo
labhyas tat-sevakottamaiḥ
samāna-mahima-śrīmat-
parivāra-gaṇāvṛtaḥ
mahā-vibhūtimān bhāti
sat-paricchada-maṇḍitaḥ
śrīmat-saṅkarṣaṇaṁ svasmād
abhinnaṁ tatra so ’rcayan
nijeṣṭa-devatātvena
kiṁ vā nātanute ’dbhutam
BB 1.2.97-98.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 97-98

BB 1.2.99.text:
tatra gantuṁ bhavāñ chaktaḥ
śrī-śive śuddha-bhaktimān
abhigamya tam āśritya
kṛpāṁ kṛṣṇasya paśyatu
BB 1.2.99.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 99

BB 1.2.100.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
ity evaṁ śikṣito mātaḥ
śiva kṛṣṇeti kīrtayan
nāradaḥ śiva-lokaṁ taṁ
prayātaḥ kautukād iva
BB 1.2.100.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 100

BB 1.3.1-4.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
bhagavantaṁ haraṁ tatra
bhāvāviṣṭatayā hareḥ
nṛtyantaṁ kīrtayantaṁ ca
kṛta-saṅkarṣaṇārcanam
bhṛśaṁ nandīśvarādīṁś ca
ślāghamānaṁ nijānugān
prītyā sa-jaya-śabdāni
gīta-vādyāni tanvataḥ
devīṁ comāṁ praśaṁsantaṁ
kara-tālīṣu kovidām
dūrād dṛṣṭvā munir hṛṣṭo
’namad vīṇāṁ ninādayan
paramānugṛhīto ’si
kṛṣṇasyeti muhur muhuḥ
jagau sarvaṁ ca pitroktaṁ
su-svaraṁ samakīrtayat
bhaje bhajanyāraṇa-pāda-paṅkajaṁ
śivasya śrī-viṣṇor ya iha guṇa-nāmādi-sakalaṁ
sva-dharma-niṣṭhaḥ śata-janmabhiḥ pumān
BB 1.3.1-4.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 1-4

BB 1.3.5-6.text:
atha śrī-rudra-pādābja-
reṇu-sparśana-kāmyayā
samīpe ’bhyāgataṁ devo
vaiṣṇavaika-priyo munim
ākṛṣyāśliṣya sammattaḥ
śrī-kṛṣṇa-rasa-dhārayā
bhṛśaṁ papraccha kiṁ brūṣe
brahma-putreti sādaram
BB 1.3.5-6.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 5-6

BB 1.3.7-8.text:
tataḥ śrī-vaiṣṇava-śreṣṭha-
sambhāṣaṇa-rasāplutam
santyakta-nṛtya-kutukaṁ
mita-priya-janāvṛtam
pārvatī-prāṇa-nāthaṁ taṁ
vṛṣyāṁ vīrāsanena saḥ
āsīnaṁ praṇaman bhaktyā
paṭhan rudra-ṣaḍ-aṅgakam
BB 1.3.7-8.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 7-8

BB 1.3.9.text:
jagad-īśatva-māhātmya-
prakāśana-paraiḥ stavaiḥ
astaud vivṛtya tasmiṁś ca
jagau kṛṣṇa-kṛpā-bharam
BB 1.3.9.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 9

BB 1.3.10.text:
karṇau pidhāya rudro ’sau
sa-krodham avadad bhṛśam
sarva-vaiṣṇava-mūrdhanyo
viṣṇu-bhakti-pravartakaḥ
BB 1.3.10.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 10

BB 1.3.11.text:
śrī-rudra uvāca
na jātu jagad-īśo ’haṁ
nāpi kṛṣṇa-kṛpāspadam
paraṁ tad-dāsa-dāsānāṁ
sadānugraha-kāmukaḥ
BB 1.3.11.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 11

BB 1.3.12.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
sambhrānto ’tha munir hitvā
kṛṣṇenaikyena tat-stutim
sāparādham ivātmānaṁ
manyamāno ’bravīc chanaiḥ
BB 1.3.12.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 12

BB 1.3.13.text:
śrī-nārada uvāca
satyam eva bhavān viṣṇor
vaiṣṇavānāṁ ca durgamām
nigūḍhāṁ mahima-śreṇīṁ
vetti vijñāpayaty api
BB 1.3.13.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 13

BB 1.3.14.text:
ato hi vaiṣṇava-śreṣṭhair
iṣyate tvad-anugrahaḥ
kṛṣṇaś ca mahimānaṁ te
prīto vitanute ’dhikam
BB 1.3.14.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 14

BB 1.3.15.text:
kati vārāṁś ca kṛṣṇena
varā vividha-mūrtibhiḥ
bhaktyā bhavantam ārādhya
gṛhītāḥ kati santi na
BB 1.3.15.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 15

BB 1.3.16.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
iti śrutvā tu sahasā
dhairyaṁ kartum aśaknuvan
lajjito drutam utthāya
nāradasya mukhaṁ haraḥ
karābhyāṁ pidadhe dhārṣṭyaṁ
mama tan na vader iti
BB 1.3.16.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 16

BB 1.3.17.text:
anantaram uvācoccaiḥ
sa-vismayam aho mune
durvitarkya-taraṁ līlā-
vaibhavaṁ dṛśyatāṁ prabhoḥ
BB 1.3.17.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 17

BB 1.3.18.text:
aho vicitra-gambhīra-
mahimābdhir mad-īśvaraḥ
vividheṣv aparādheṣu
nopekṣeta kṛteṣv api
BB 1.3.18.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 18

BB 1.3.19.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
paramānandito dhṛtvā
pādayor upaveśya tam
nāradaḥ parituṣṭāva
kṛṣṇa-bhakti-rasa-plutam
BB 1.3.19.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 19

BB 1.3.20.text:
śrī-nārada uvāca
nāparādhāvakāśas te
preyasaḥ kaścid acyute
kadācil loka-dṛṣṭyāpi
jāto nāsmin prakāśate
BB 1.3.20.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 20

BB 1.3.21-22.text:
sva-bāhu-bala-dṛptasya
sādhūpadrava-kāriṇaḥ
māyā-baddhāniruddhasya
yudhyamānasya cakriṇā
hata-prāyasya bāṇasya
nija-bhaktasya putra-vat
pālitasya tvayā prāṇa-
rakṣārthaṁ śrī-hariḥ stutaḥ
BB 1.3.21-22.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 21-22

BB 1.3.23.text:
sadyo hitvā ruṣaṁ prīto
dattvā nija-svarūpatām
bhavat-pārṣadatāṁ ninye
taṁ durāpāṁ surair api
catvāro ’sya bhujāḥ śiṣṭā
BB 1.3.23.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 23

BB 1.3.24.text:
bhavāṁś ca vaiṣṇava-drohi-
gārgyādibhyaḥ su-duścaraiḥ
tapobhir bhajamānebhyo
nāvyalīkaṁ varaṁ dade
BB 1.3.24.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 24

BB 1.3.25.text:
citraketu-prabhṛtayo
’dhiyo ’py aṁśāśritā hareḥ
nindakā yady api svasya
tebhyo ’kupyas tathāpi na
BB 1.3.25.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 25

BB 1.3.26.text:
kṛṣṇasya prītaye tasmāc
chraiṣṭhyam apy abhivāñchatā
tad-bhaktataiva cāturya-
viśeṣeṇārthitā tvayā
alabdhvā cātmanaḥ pūjāṁ
BB 1.3.26.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 26

BB 1.3.27.text:
ato brahmādi-samprārthya-
mukti-dānādhikāritām
bhavate bhagavatyai ca
durgāyai bhagavān adāt
BB 1.3.27.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 27

BB 1.3.28.text:
aho brahmādi-duṣprāpye
aiśvarye saty apīdṛśe
tat sarvaṁ sukham apy ātmyam
anādṛtyāvadhūta-vat
BB 1.3.28.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 28

BB 1.3.29.text:
bhāvāviṣṭaḥ sadā viṣṇor
mahonmāda-gṛhīta-vat
ko ’nyaḥ patnyā samaṁ nṛtyed
gaṇair api dig-ambaraḥ
BB 1.3.29.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 29

BB 1.3.30.text:
dṛṣṭo ’dya bhagavad-bhakti-
lāmpaṭya-mahimādbhutaḥ
tad bhavān eva kṛṣṇasya
nityaṁ parama-vallabhaḥ
BB 1.3.30.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 30

BB 1.3.31.text:
āḥ kiṁ vācyānavacchinnā
kṛṣṇasya priyatā tvayi
tvat-prasādena bahavo
’nye ’pi tat-priyatāṁ gatāḥ
BB 1.3.31.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 31

BB 1.3.32.text:
pārvatyāś ca prasādena
bahavas tat-priyāḥ kṛtāḥ
tattvābhijñā viśeṣeṇa
bhavator iyam eva hi
BB 1.3.32.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 32

BB 1.3.33.text:
kṛṣṇasya bhaginī vaiṣā
sneha-pātraṁ sadāmbikā
ata eva bhavān ātmā-
rāmo ’py etām apekṣate
BB 1.3.33.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 33

BB 1.3.34.text:
vicitra-bhagavan-nāma-
saṅkīrtana-kathotsavaiḥ
sademāṁ ramayan viṣṇu-
jana-saṅga-sukhaṁ bhajet
BB 1.3.34.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 34

BB 1.3.35.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
tato maheśvaro mātas
trapāvanamitānanaḥ
nāradaṁ bhagavad-bhaktam
avadad vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ
BB 1.3.35.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 35

BB 1.3.36.text:
śrī-maheśa uvāca
aho bata mahat kaṣṭaṁ
tyakta-sarvābhimāna he
kvāhaṁ sarvābhimānānāṁ
mūlaṁ kva tādṛśeśvaraḥ
BB 1.3.36.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 36

BB 1.3.37.text:
lokeśo jñāna-do jñānī
mukto mukti-prado ’py aham
bhakto bhakti-prado viṣṇor
ity-ādy-ahaṅ-kriyāvṛtaḥ
BB 1.3.37.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 37

BB 1.3.38.text:
sarva-grāsa-kare ghore
mahā-kāle samāgate
villaje ’śeṣa-saṁhāra-
tāmasa-sva-prayojanāt
BB 1.3.38.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 38

BB 1.3.39.text:
mayi nārada varteta
kṛpā-leśo ’pi ced dhareḥ
tadā kiṁ pārijātoṣā-
haraṇādau mayā raṇaḥ
BB 1.3.39.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 39

BB 1.3.40.text:
māṁ kim ārādhayed dāsaṁ
kim etac cādiśet prabhuḥ
svāgamaiḥ kalpitais tvaṁ ca
janān mad-vimukhān kuru
BB 1.3.40.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 40

BB 1.3.41.text:
āvayor mukti-dātṛtvaṁ
yad bhavān stauti hṛṣṭa-vat
tac cāti-dāruṇaṁ tasya
bhaktānāṁ śruti-duḥkha-dam
BB 1.3.41.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 41

BB 1.3.42.text:
tat kṛṣṇa-pārṣada-śreṣṭha
mā māṁ tasya dayāspadam
viddhi kintu kṛpā-sāra-
bhājo vaikuṇṭha-vāsinaḥ
BB 1.3.42.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 42

BB 1.3.43.text:
yaiḥ sarvaṁ tṛṇa-vat tyaktvā
bhaktyārādhya priyaṁ harim
sarvārtha-siddhayo labdhvā-
pāṅga-dṛṣṭyāpi nādṛtāḥ
BB 1.3.43.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 43

BB 1.3.44.text:
tyakta-sarvābhimānā ye
samasta-bhaya-varjitam
vaikuṇṭhaṁ sac-cid-ānandaṁ
guṇātītaṁ padaṁ gatāḥ
lokaṁ vaikuṇṭha-nāmānaṁ
nitya-siddhaiḥ samākīrṇaḥ
vāpī-kūpa-taḍāgaiś ca
tam ananta-guṇāvāsaṁ
tasmai sva-lokaṁ bhagavān sabhājitaḥ
pravartate yatra rajas tamas tayoḥ
iti sañcintya bhagavān
satyaṁ jñānam anantaṁ yad
BB 1.3.44.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 44

BB 1.3.45.text:
tatra ye sac-cid-ānanda-
dehāḥ parama-vaibhavam
samprāptaṁ sac-cid-ānandaṁ
hari-sārṣṭiṁ ca nābhajan
BB 1.3.45.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 45

BB 1.3.46.text:
kamalā-lālyamānāṅghri-
kamalaṁ moda-vardhanam
sampaśyanto hariṁ sākṣād
ramante saha tena ye
pārāvatānyabhṛta-sārasa-cakravāka-
mandāra-kunda-kurabotpala-campakārṇa-
BB 1.3.46.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 46

BB 1.3.47.text:
muktān upahasantīva
vaikuṇṭhe satataṁ prabhum
bhajantaḥ pakṣi-vṛkṣādi-
rūpair vividha-sevayā
BB 1.3.47.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 47

BB 1.3.49.text:
aho kāruṇya-mahimā
śrī-kṛṣṇasya kuto ’nyataḥ
vaikuṇṭha-loke yo ’jasraṁ
tadīyeṣu ca rājate
BB 1.3.49.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 49

BB 1.3.50.text:
yasmin mahā-mudāśrāntaṁ
prabhoḥ saṅkīrtanādibhiḥ
vicitrām antarā bhaktiṁ
nāsty anyat prema-vāhinīm
BB 1.3.50.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 50

BB 1.3.51.text:
aho tat-paramānanda-
rasābdher mahimādbhutaḥ
brahmānandas tulāṁ nārhed
yat-kaṇārdhāṁśakena ca
BB 1.3.51.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 51

BB 1.3.52.text:
sa vaikuṇṭhas tadīyāś ca
tatratyam akhilaṁ ca yat
tad eva kṛṣṇa-pādābja-
para-premānukampitam
BB 1.3.52.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 52

BB 1.3.53.text:
tādṛk-kāruṇya-pātrāṇāṁ
śrīmad-vaikuṇṭha-vāsinām
matto ’dhika-taras tat-tan-
mahimā kiṁ nu varṇyatām
BB 1.3.53.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 53

BB 1.3.54.text:
pāñca-bhautika-dehā ye
martya-loka-nivāsinaḥ
bhagavad-bhakti-rasikā
namasyā mādṛśāṁ sadā
ye tyakta-loka-dharmārthā
BB 1.3.54.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 54

BB 1.3.55.text:
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇāmbhojā-
rpitātmāno hi ye kila
tad-eka-prema-lābhāśā-
tyaktārtha-jana-jīvanāḥ
BB 1.3.55.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 55

BB 1.3.56.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 56

BB 1.3.57.text:
ṛṇa-trayād anirmuktā
veda-mārgātigā api
hari-bhakti-balāvegād
akutaścid-bhayāḥ sadā
BB 1.3.57.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 57

BB 1.3.58.text:
nānyat kim api vāñchanti
tad-bhakti-rasa-lampaṭāḥ
svargāpavarga-narakeṣv
api tulyārtha-darśinaḥ
ṛṇais tribhir dvijo jāto
tāvat karmāṇi kurvīta
sarva-dharmān parityajya
tyaktvā sva-dharmaṁ caraṇāmbujaṁ harer
nārāyaṇa-parāḥ sarve
BB 1.3.58.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 58

BB 1.3.59.text:
bhagavān iva satyaṁ me
ta eva parama-priyāḥ
parama-prārthanīyaś ca
mama taiḥ saha saṅgamaḥ
atha bhāgavatā yūyaṁ
BB 1.3.59.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 59

BB 1.3.60.text:
nāradāham idaṁ manye
tādṛśānāṁ yataḥ sthitiḥ
bhavet sa eva vaikuṇṭho
loko nātra vicāraṇā
nāhaṁ vasāmi vaikuṇṭhe
BB 1.3.60.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 60

BB 1.3.61.text:
kṛṣṇa-bhakti-sudhā-pānād
deha-daihika-vismṛteḥ
teṣāṁ bhautika-dehe ’pi
sac-cid-ānanda-rūpatā
parītyābhyarcya dhiṣṇyāgryaṁ
BB 1.3.61.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 61

BB 1.3.62.text:
paraṁ bhagavatā sākaṁ
sākṣāt krīḍā-paramparāḥ
sadānubhavituṁ tair hi
vaikuṇṭho ’pekṣyate kvacit
BB 1.3.62.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 62

BB 1.3.63.text:
ato hi sarve tatratyā
mayoktāḥ sarvato ’dhikāḥ
dayā-viśeṣa-viṣayāḥ
kṛṣṇasya parama-priyāḥ
BB 1.3.63.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 63

BB 1.3.64.text:
śrī-pārvaty uvāca
tatrāpi śrīr viśeṣeṇa
prasiddhā śrī-hari-priyā
tādṛg-vaikuṇṭha-vaikuṇṭha-
vāsinām īśvarī hi yā
BB 1.3.64.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 64

BB 1.3.65.text:
yasyāḥ kaṭākṣa-pātena
loka-pāla-vibhūtayaḥ
jñānaṁ viraktir bhaktiś ca
sidhyanti yad-anugrahāt
yataḥ sattvaṁ tato lakṣmīḥ
yajña-vidyā mahā-vidyā
BB 1.3.65.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 65

BB 1.3.66.text:
yā vihāyādareṇāpi
bhajamānān bhavādṛśān
vavre tapobhir ārādhya
nirapekṣaṁ ca taṁ priyam
kasyānubhāvo ’sya na deva vidmahe
BB 1.3.66.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 66

BB 1.3.67.text:
karoti vasatiṁ nityaṁ
yā ramye tasya vakṣasi
pati-vratottamāśeṣā-
vatāreṣv anuyāty amum
evaṁ yathā jagat-svāmī
devatve deva-deheyaṁ
BB 1.3.67.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 67

BB 1.3.68.text:
śrī-parīkṣid uvāca
tataḥ parama-harṣeṇa
kṣobhitātmālapan muniḥ
jaya śrī-kamalā-kānta
he vaikuṇṭha-pate hare
BB 1.3.68.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 68

BB 1.3.69.text:
jaya vaikuṇṭha-loketi
tatratyā jayateti ca
jaya kṛṣṇa-priye padme
vaikuṇṭhādhīśvarīty api
BB 1.3.69.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 69

BB 1.3.70.text:
athābhinandanāyāsyā
vaikuṇṭhe gantum utthitaḥ
abhipretya hareṇoktaḥ
kare dhṛtvā nivārya saḥ
BB 1.3.70.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 70

BB 1.3.71.text:
śrī-maheśa uvāca
kṛṣṇa-priya-janālokot-
sukatā-vihata-smṛte
na kiṁ smarasi yad bhūmau
dvārakāyāṁ vasaty asau
BB 1.3.71.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 71

BB 1.3.72.text:
rukmiṇī sā mahā-lakṣmīḥ
kṛṣṇas tu bhagavān svayam
tasyā aṁśāvatārā hi
vāmanādi-samīpataḥ
BB 1.3.72.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 72

BB 1.3.73.text:
sampūrṇā paripūrṇasya
lakṣmīr bhagavataḥ sadā
niṣevate padāmbhoje
śrī-kṛṣṇasyaiva rukmiṇī
BB 1.3.73.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 73

BB 1.3.74.text:
tasmād upaviśa brahman
rahasyaṁ paramaṁ śanaiḥ
karṇe te kathayāmy ekaṁ
parama-śraddhayā śṛṇu
BB 1.3.74.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 74

BB 1.3.75.text:
tvat-tātato mad garuḍāditaś ca
śriyo ’pi kāruṇya-viśeṣa-pātram
prahlāda eva prathito jagatyāṁ
kṛṣṇasya bhakto nitarāṁ priyaś ca
BB 1.3.75.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 75

BB 1.3.76.text:
bhagavad-vacanāni tvaṁ
kiṁ nu vismṛtavān asi
adhītāni purāṇeṣu
ślokam etaṁ na kiṁ smareḥ
BB 1.3.76.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 76

BB 1.3.77.text:
nāham ātmānam āśāse
mad-bhaktaiḥ sādhubhir vinā
śriyam ātyantikīṁ vāpi
yeṣāṁ gatir ahaṁ parā
ahaṁ bhakta-parādhīno
mayi nirbaddha-hṛdayāḥ
na tathā me priya-tama
