nāma-saṅkīrtana-stotra-
gītāni bhagavat-puraḥ
śrūyamāṇāni dunvanti
mathurā-smārakāṇi mām
BB 2.1.206.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 206

BB 2.1.207.text:
sādhu-saṅga-balād gatvā
dṛṣṭe rājīva-locane
sarvaḥ śoko vilīyeta
na syāj jigamiṣā kvacit
BB 2.1.207.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 207

BB 2.1.208.text:
tathāpi mama sāmrājya-
samparkeṇa hṛdi svataḥ
bhagavad-darśanānandaḥ
samyaṅ nodeti pūrva-vat
BB 2.1.208.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 208

BB 2.1.209.text:
yātrā-mahotsavāṁś cāham
āvṛto rāja-maṇḍalaiḥ
sukhaṁ kalayituṁ neśe
svecchayā bahudhā bhajan
BB 2.1.209.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 209

BB 2.1.210.text:
rājño ’patyeṣv amātyeṣu
bandhuṣv api samarpya tam
rājya-bhāraṁ svayaṁ prāg-vad
udāsīnatayā sthitaḥ
BB 2.1.210.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 210

BB 2.1.211.text:
sukhaṁ raho japaṁ kurvan
jagannātha-padābjayoḥ
samīpe svecchayā sevām
ācarann avasaṁ tataḥ
BB 2.1.211.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 211

BB 2.1.212.text:
tathāpi loka-sammānā-
daratas tādṛśaṁ sukham
na labheya vinirviṇṇa-
manās tatrābhavaṁ sthitau
BB 2.1.212.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 212

BB 2.1.213.text:
gantuṁ vṛndāvanaṁ prātar
ājñārthaṁ purataḥ prabhoḥ
gataḥ śrīman-mukhaṁ paśyan
sarvaṁ tad vismarāmy aho
BB 2.1.213.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 213

BB 2.1.214.text:
evaṁ saṁvatsare jāte
mayā tatraikadā śrutam
mathurāyāḥ prāyātebhyo
’tratya-vṛttaṁ viśeṣataḥ
BB 2.1.214.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 214

BB 2.1.215.text:
śoka-duḥkhāturaṁ rātrau
śayānaṁ māṁ mahā-prabhuḥ
idam ājñāpayām āsa
para-duḥkhena kātaraḥ
BB 2.1.215.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 215

BB 2.1.216.text:
bho gopa-nandana kṣetram
idaṁ mama yathā priyam
tathā śrī-mathurā ’thāsau
janma-bhūmir viśeṣataḥ
BB 2.1.216.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 216

BB 2.1.217.text:
bālya-līlā-sthalībhiś ca
tābhis tābhir alaṅkṛtā
nivasāmi yathātrāhaṁ
tathā tatrāpi vibhraman
janma bālyaṁ tataḥ sar
BB 2.1.217.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 217

BB 2.1.218.text:
sadā dolāyamānātmā
kathaṁ tad anutapyase
tatraiva gaccha kāle māṁ
tad-rūpaṁ drakṣyasi dhruvam
BB 2.1.218.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 218

BB 2.1.219.text:
ājñā-mālāṁ prātar ādāya pūjā-
viprair vāse me samāgatya dattām
kaṇṭhe baddhvā prasthito vīkṣya cakraṁ
natvāthāpto māthuraṁ deśam etam
BB 2.1.219.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 1, Text 219

BB 2.2.1.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
māthurottama viśrāntau
snātvā vṛndāvanaṁ gataḥ
atra govardhanādau ca
yathā-kāmaṁ paribhraman
BB 2.2.1.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 1

BB 2.2.2.text:
pibaṁś ca go-rasaṁ pūrva-
bāndhavais tair alakṣitaḥ
bhajan sva-japyam anayaṁ
dināni katicit sukham
BB 2.2.2.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 2

BB 2.2.3.text:
atha sandarśanotkaṇṭhā
jagad-īśasya sājani
yayedaṁ śūnya-vad vīkṣya
puruṣottamam asmaram
puṇyaṁ madhu-vanaṁ yatra
mathurā bhagavān yatra
puṇyā bata vraja-bhuvo yad ayaṁ nṛ-liṅg
BB 2.2.3.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 3

BB 2.2.4.text:
ārtas tatra jagannāthaṁ
draṣṭum oḍhrān punar vrajan
pathi gaṅgā-taṭe ’paśyaṁ
dharmācāra-parān dvijān
BB 2.2.4.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 4

BB 2.2.5.text:
vicitra-śāstra-vijñebhyas
tebhyaś cāśrauṣam adbhutam
svargo nāmordhva-deśe ’sti
deva-loko ’ntarīkṣataḥ
BB 2.2.5.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 5

BB 2.2.6.text:
vimānāvalibhiḥ śrīmān
nirbhayo duḥkha-varjitaḥ
jarā-maraṇa-rogādi-
doṣa-varga-bahiṣkṛtaḥ
BB 2.2.6.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 6

BB 2.2.7.text:
mahā-sukha-mayo labhyaḥ
puṇyair atrottamaiḥ kṛtaiḥ
yasya śakro ’dhipo jyāyān
bhrātā śrī-jagad-īśituḥ
BB 2.2.7.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 7

BB 2.2.8-9.text:
yady apy asti bila-svargo
viṣṇu-śeṣādy-alaṅkṛtaḥ
bhauma-svargaś ca tad-dvīpa-
varṣādiṣu pade pade
vicitra-rūpa-śrī-kṛṣṇa-
pūjotsava-virājitaḥ
tathāpy ūrdhva-taro loko
divyas tābhyāṁ viśiṣyate
BB 2.2.8-9.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 8-9

BB 2.2.10.text:
yasmin śrī-jagad-īśo ’sti
sākṣād aditi-nandanaḥ
tasyopendrasya vārtā ca
śrī-viṣṇor adbhutā śrutā
mamopari yathendras tvaṁ
BB 2.2.10.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 10

BB 2.2.11.text:
āruhya pakṣīndram itas tato ’sau
krīḍan vinighnann asurān mano-jñaiḥ
līlā-vacobhī ramayann ajasraṁ
devān nija-bhrātṛtayārcyate taiḥ
BB 2.2.11.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 11

BB 2.2.12.text:
tad-darśane jāta-manorathākulaḥ
saṅkalpa-pūrvaṁ sva-japaṁ samācaran
sv-alpena kālena vimānam āgataṁ
mudāham āruhya gatas tri-piṣṭapam
BB 2.2.12.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 12

BB 2.2.13.text:
pūrvaṁ gaṅgā-taṭa-nṛpa-gṛhe yasya dṛṣṭā pratiṣṭhā
taṁ śrī-viṣṇuṁ sura-gaṇa-vṛtaṁ sac-cid-ānanda-sāndram
tatrāpaśyaṁ rucira-garuḍa-skandha-siṁhāsana-sthaṁ
vīṇā-gītaṁ madhura-madhuraṁ nāradasyārcayantam
BB 2.2.13.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 13

BB 2.2.14.text:
prāpya prāpyaṁ draṣṭum iṣṭaṁ ca dṛṣṭvā
tatrātmānaṁ manyamānaḥ kṛtārtham
dūrād bhūyo daṇḍa-vad vandamānas
tenāhūto ’nugraha-snigdha-vācā
BB 2.2.14.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 14

BB 2.2.15.text:
diṣṭyā diṣṭyāgato ’si tvam
atra śrī-gopa-nandana
alaṁ daṇḍa-praṇāmair me
nikaṭe ’nusarābhayam
BB 2.2.15.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 15

BB 2.2.16.text:
tasyājñayā mahendreṇa
preritais tri-daśair aham
agrataḥ sādaraṁ nītvā
prayatnād upaveśitaḥ
BB 2.2.16.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 16

BB 2.2.17.text:
divyair dravyais tarpito nandanākhye
’raṇye vāsaṁ prāpito ’gāṁ praharṣam
vīkṣe kācit tatra bhīr nāsti śoko
rogo mṛtyur glānir ārtir jarā ca
BB 2.2.17.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 17

BB 2.2.18.text:
santu vā katicid doṣās
tān ahaṁ gaṇayāmi na
tādṛśaṁ jagad-īśasya
sandarśana-sukhaṁ bhajan
BB 2.2.18.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 18

BB 2.2.19.text:
mahendreṇārcyate svarga-
vibhūtibhir asau prabhuḥ
bhrātṛtveneśvaratvena
śaraṇatvena cānv-aham
BB 2.2.19.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 19

BB 2.2.20-21.text:
manasy akaravaṁ caitad
aho dhanyaḥ śatakratuḥ
yo hi śrī-viṣṇunā dattaṁ
sādhayitvā nirākulam
trai-lokyaiśvaryam āsādya
bhagavantam imaṁ mudā
upahāra-cayair divyair
gṛhyamāṇaiḥ svayaṁ yajet
BB 2.2.20-21.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 20-21

BB 2.2.22.text:
evaṁ mamāpi bhagavān
ayaṁ kiṁ kṛpayiṣyati
iti tatrāvasaṁ kurvan
sva-saṅkalpaṁ nijaṁ japam
BB 2.2.22.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 22

BB 2.2.23.text:
athaikasya munīndrasya
dūṣayitvā priyāṁ balāt
lajjayā śāpa-bhītyā ca
śakraḥ kutrāpy alīyata
BB 2.2.23.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 23

BB 2.2.24.text:
daivair anviṣya bahudhā
sa na prāpto yadā tataḥ
arājakatvāt trai-lokyam
abhibhūtam upadravaiḥ
BB 2.2.24.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 24

BB 2.2.25.text:
śrī-viṣṇor ājñayā devair
guruṇā preritair atha
aindre pade ’bhiṣikto ’ham
adity-ādy-anumoditaḥ
BB 2.2.25.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 25

BB 2.2.26.text:
tato ’ditiṁ śacīṁ jīvaṁ
brāhmaṇān api mānayan
trai-lokye vaiṣṇavīṁ bhaktiṁ
pūrṇāṁ prāvartayaṁ sadā
yuge yuge bhavanty et
sarva-kalpeṣu cāpy evaṁ
BB 2.2.26.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 26

BB 2.2.27.text:
svayaṁ tasyāḥ prabhāveṇa
svārājye ’pi yathā purā
sadākiñcana-rūpe ’haṁ
nyavasaṁ nandane vane
BB 2.2.27.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 27

BB 2.2.28.text:
atyajaṁś ca japaṁ svīyam
akṛtajñatva-śaṅkayā
vismartuṁ naiva śaknomi
vraja-bhūmim imāṁ kvacit
BB 2.2.28.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 28

BB 2.2.29.text:
tac-choka-duḥkhair anutapyamānaḥ
śuṣkānano ’haṁ jagad-īśvareṇa
saṁlakṣya toṣyeya muhuḥ karābja-
sparśena citrair vacanāmṛtaiś ca
BB 2.2.29.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 29

BB 2.2.30.text:
jyeṣṭha-sodara-sambandham
iva pālayatā svayam
mat-toṣaṇāya mad-dattaṁ
bhogyam ādāya bhujyate
BB 2.2.30.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 30

BB 2.2.31.text:
tena vismṛtya tad duḥkhaṁ
pūjayāpūrva-vṛttayā
prīṇayan sneha-bhāvāttaṁ
lālayeyaṁ kaniṣṭha-vat
BB 2.2.31.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 31

BB 2.2.32.text:
evaṁ māṁ svāsthyam āpādya
sva-sthāne kutracid gataḥ
upendro vasati śrīmān
na labhyeta sadekṣitum
BB 2.2.32.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 32

BB 2.2.33.text:
tato yo jāyate śokas
tena nīlācala-prabhum
acalāśrita-vātsalyaṁ
draṣṭum iccheyam etya tam
prādurbhūtasya viṣṇos tu
tasya tādṛk-kṛpā-bharaiḥ
ādhiḥ sarvo vilīyeta
pāścātyo ’pi tad-āśayā
BB 2.2.33.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 33

BB 2.2.35.text:
evaṁ nivasatā tatra
śakratvam adhikurvatā
brahman saṁvatsaro divyo
mayaiko gamitaḥ sukham
BB 2.2.35.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 35

BB 2.2.36.text:
akasmād āgatās tatra
bhṛgu-mukhyā maharṣayaḥ
padbhyāṁ pāvayituṁ yāntas
tīrthāṇi kṛpayā bhuvi
tri-lokyāṁ dahyamānāyāṁ
BB 2.2.36.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 36

BB 2.2.37.text:
sa-sambhramaṁ suraiḥ sarvair
ṛṣibhir guruṇā svayam
viṣṇunā cārcyamānās te
mayā dṛṣṭāḥ sa-vismayam
BB 2.2.37.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 37

BB 2.2.38.text:
ahaṁ cābhinavo viṣṇu-
sevānanda-hṛtāntaraḥ
na jāne tān atha svīyaiḥ
preritas tair apūjayam
BB 2.2.38.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 38

BB 2.2.39.text:
abhinandya śubhāśīrbhir
māṁ te ’gacchan yathā-sukham
tirobhavad upendro ’pi
mayā pṛṣṭās tadāmarāḥ
BB 2.2.39.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 39

BB 2.2.40.text:
pūjyā devā nṛṇāṁ pūjyā
devānām apy amī tu ke
kiṁ-māhātmyā mahā-tejo-
mayāḥ kutra vasanti vā
BB 2.2.40.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 40

BB 2.2.41.text:
mahābhimānibhir devair
matsarākrānta-mānasaiḥ
lajjayeva na tad-vṛttam
uktaṁ gurur athābravīt
BB 2.2.41.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 41

BB 2.2.42.text:
śrī-bṛhaspatir uvāca
ata ūrdhvaṁ mahar-loko
rājate karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ
prāpyo mahadbhir yo naśyet
trai-lokya-pralaye ’pi na
BB 2.2.42.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 42

BB 2.2.43.text:
yathā hi koṭi-guṇitaṁ
sāmrājyāt sukham aindrikam
tat-koṭi-guṇitaṁ tatra
prājāpatyaṁ sukhaṁ matam
BB 2.2.43.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 43

BB 2.2.44.text:
tenāmī sevitās tatra
nivasanti mahā-sukhaiḥ
yajñeśvaraṁ prabhuṁ sākṣāt
pūjayantaḥ pade pade
BB 2.2.44.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 44

BB 2.2.45.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
tac chrutvaindra-pade sadyo
nirvidyaicchaṁ tam īkṣitum
pūjya-pūjyair mahadbhis taiḥ
pūjyamānaṁ mahā-prabhum
BB 2.2.45.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 45

BB 2.2.46.text:
tat saṅkalpya japaṁ kurvann
acirād ūrdhvam utthitaḥ
vyoma-yānena taṁ prāpto
lokaṁ tatra vyalokayam
BB 2.2.46.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 46

BB 2.2.47.text:
trai-lokye yat sukhaṁ nāsti
vaibhavaṁ bhajanaṁ tathā
nirdoṣaṁ tatra tat sarvam
asty anirvācyam āśu tat
BB 2.2.47.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 47

BB 2.2.48.text:
vitāyamāneṣu mahā-makheṣu tair
maharṣibhir bhakti-paraiḥ sahasraśaḥ
makhāgni-madhye prabhur utthitaḥ sphuran
makheśvaraḥ krīḍati yajña-bhāga-bhuk
BB 2.2.48.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 48

BB 2.2.49.text:
sa yajña-mūrtī ravi-koṭi-tejā
jagan-manohāri-mahā-pratīkaḥ
prasārya hastāṁś carum ādadāno
varān priyān yacchati yājakebhyaḥ
rūpaṁ tavaitan nanu duṣkṛtātmanāṁ
sruk tuṇḍa āsīt sruva īśa nāsayor
BB 2.2.49.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 49

BB 2.2.50.text:
tad-darśanojjṛmbhita-sambhramāya
harṣān namaskāra-parāya mahyam
datto nijocchiṣṭa-mahā-prasādas
tena sva-hastena dayārdra-vācā
BB 2.2.50.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 50

BB 2.2.51.text:
apūrva-labdham ānandaṁ
paramaṁ prāpnuvaṁs tataḥ
kāruṇyātiśayāt tasya
saṁsiddhāśeṣa-vāñchitaḥ
BB 2.2.51.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 51

BB 2.2.52.text:
dayālūnāṁ maharṣīṇāṁ
saṅgatyetas tato bhraman
praty-āvāsaṁ tathaivāham
adrākṣaṁ jagad-īśvaram
BB 2.2.52.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 52

BB 2.2.53.text:
tataḥ kṛtārthatā-niṣṭhāṁ
manvānaḥ svasya sarvathā
sānandaṁ nivasaṁs tatra
prokto ’haṁ tair maharṣibhiḥ
BB 2.2.53.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 53

BB 2.2.54.text:
śrī-maharṣaya ūcuḥ
bho gopa-vaiśya-putra tvam
etal-loka-svabhāva-jam
pradīyamānam asmābhir
vipratvaṁ svī-kuru drutam
BB 2.2.54.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 54

BB 2.2.55.text:
maharṣīṇām ekatamo
bhūtvā tvam api pūjaya
jagad-īśam imaṁ yajñaiś
ciram ātma-didṛkṣitam
BB 2.2.55.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 55

BB 2.2.56.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
tac chrutvācintayaṁ brahman
vaiśyatve syāt sukhaṁ mahat
prabhor eṣāṁ ca viprāṇāṁ
tad-bhaktānām upāsanāt
BB 2.2.56.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 56

BB 2.2.57.text:
eṣāṁ yajñaika-niṣṭhānām
aikyenāvaśyake nije
jape ca sad-gurūddiṣṭe
māndyaṁ syād dṛṣṭa-sat-phale
BB 2.2.57.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 57

BB 2.2.58.text:
tatas tān anumānyāham
anaṅgī-kṛtya vipratām
tatrāvasaṁ svato jāta-
prājāpatya-mahā-sukhaiḥ
BB 2.2.58.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 58

BB 2.2.59.text:
na doṣās tatra śoko vā
śaṅkā vā kāpi vidyate
nānyac ca kiñcid yajñeśa-
prītyai yajñotsavān ṛte
BB 2.2.59.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 59

BB 2.2.60.text:
kintu yajña-samāptau syād
duḥkham antarhite prabhau
vṛtte yajñāntare cāsya
prādurbhāvāt punaḥ sukham
BB 2.2.60.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 60

BB 2.2.61.text:
catur-yuga-sahasrasya
tatratyaika-dinasya hi
ante trai-lokya-dāhena
jana-loko ’dhigamyate
BB 2.2.61.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 61

BB 2.2.62.text:
rajanyām iva jātāyāṁ
yajñābhāvena tatra tu
yajñeśādarśanena syād
dāhas tad-dāhato ’dhikaḥ
BB 2.2.62.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 62

BB 2.2.63.text:
tato ’kṣaya-vaṭa-cchāye
kṣetre śrī-puruṣottame
āgatya śrī-jagannāthaṁ
paśyeyam iti rocate
BB 2.2.63.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 63

BB 2.2.64.text:
mahar-loke gate ’py ātma-
japād rahasi pūrva-vat
sampādyamānāc chokaḥ syād
asyā bhūmer didṛkṣayā
BB 2.2.64.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 64

BB 2.2.65.text:
prādurbhūto ’tha bhagavān
ijyamāno dayā-nidhiḥ
yadā mām āhvayet prītyā
man-nītaṁ līlayātti ca
BB 2.2.65.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 65

BB 2.2.66.text:
tadānīyeta sarvārtis
tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā
rātrāv api tad-ekāśā-
baddho neśe kvacid gatau
BB 2.2.66.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 66

BB 2.2.67.text:
tatraikadā mahā-tejaḥ-
puñja-rūpo dig-ambaraḥ
pāñca-ṣābdika-bālābhaḥ
ko ’py āgād ūrdhva-lokataḥ
BB 2.2.67.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 67

BB 2.2.68.text:
vihāya yajña-karmāṇi
bhaktyotthāya maharṣibhiḥ
praṇamya dhyāna-niṣṭho ’sau
yajñeśvara-vad arcitaḥ
BB 2.2.68.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 68

BB 2.2.69.text:
yathā-kāmaṁ gate tasmin
mayā pṛṣṭā maharṣayaḥ
kutratyaḥ katamo vāyaṁ
bhavadbhir vārcitaḥ katham
BB 2.2.69.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 69

BB 2.2.70.text:
śrī-maharṣaya ūcuḥ
sanat-kumāra-nāmāyaṁ
jyeṣṭho ’smākaṁ mahat-tamaḥ
ātmārāmāpta-kāmānām
ādyācāryo bṛhad-vrataḥ
BB 2.2.70.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 70

BB 2.2.71.text:
ita ūrdhva-tare loke
tapaḥ-saṁjñe vasaty asau
bhrātṛbhis tribhir anyaiś ca
yogīndraiḥ sva-samaiḥ saha
BB 2.2.71.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 71

BB 2.2.72.text:
bṛhad-vrataika-labhyo yaḥ
kṣemaṁ yasmin sadā sukham
prājāpatyāt sukhāt koṭi-
guṇitaṁ cordhva-retasam
BB 2.2.72.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 72

BB 2.2.73.text:
yathā yajñeśvaraḥ pūjyas
tathāyaṁ ca viśeṣataḥ
gṛha-sthānām ivāsmākaṁ
sva-kṛtya-tyāgato ’pi ca
BB 2.2.73.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 73

BB 2.2.74.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
tato ’karṣam ahaṁ citte
tatrāho kīdṛśaṁ sukham
īdṛśāḥ kati vānye syur
eṣāṁ pūjyaś ca kīdṛśaḥ
BB 2.2.74.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 74

BB 2.2.75.text:
evaṁ tāñ ca didṛkṣuḥ san
samāhita-manā japan
bhūtvā parama-tejasvī
taṁ lokaṁ vegato ’gamam
BB 2.2.75.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 75

BB 2.2.76.text:
tatra dṛṣṭo mayā śrīmān
sanako ’tha sanandanaḥ
asau sanat-kumāro ’pi
caturthaś ca sanātanaḥ
BB 2.2.76.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 76

BB 2.2.77.text:
sammanyamānās tatratyais
tādṛśair eva te mithaḥ
sukha-goṣṭhīṁ vitanvānāḥ
santy agamyāṁ hi mādṛśaiḥ
BB 2.2.77.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 77

BB 2.2.78.text:
bhagaval-lakṣaṇaṁ teṣu
tādṛṅ nāsti tathāpy abhūt
teṣāṁ sandarśanāt tatra
mahān modo mama svataḥ
BB 2.2.78.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 78

BB 2.2.79.text:
yathā-sthānaṁ prayāteṣu
dhyāna-niṣṭheṣu teṣv atha
draṣṭuṁ bhramāmi sambhāvya
pūrva-vaj jagad-īśvaram
BB 2.2.79.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 79

BB 2.2.80.text:
itas tato na dṛṣṭvā tam
apṛcchaṁ tān mahā-munīn
na te stuvantaṁ mām agre
namantaṁ lokayanty api
BB 2.2.80.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 80

BB 2.2.81.text:
prāyaḥ sarve samādhi-sthā
naiṣṭhikā ūrdhva-retasaḥ
svātmārāmāḥ pūrṇa-kāmāḥ
sevyamānāś ca siddhibhiḥ
BB 2.2.81.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 81

BB 2.2.82.text:
bhagavad-darśanāśā ca
mahatī phalitā na me
utābhūd viramantīva
teṣāṁ saṅga-svabhāvataḥ
BB 2.2.82.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 82

BB 2.2.83.text:
tatrāthāpy avasaṁ teṣāṁ
prabhāva-bhara-darśanāt
guru-vāg-gauravād dṛṣṭa-
phalatvāc cātyajan japam
BB 2.2.83.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 83

BB 2.2.84.text:
sthāna-svabhāva-jāc citta-
prasādānandato ’dhikam
tena sampadyamānena
sā didṛkṣā vivardhitā
BB 2.2.84.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 84

BB 2.2.85.text:
sadā nīlācale rājaj-
jagannātha-didṛkṣayā
yiyāsuṁ tatra saṁlakṣyā-
bravīn māṁ pippalāyanaḥ
BB 2.2.85.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 85

BB 2.2.86.text:
śrī-pippalāyana uvāca
idaṁ mahat padaṁ hitvā
katham anyad yiyāsasi
kathaṁ vā bhramasi draṣṭuṁ
dṛgbhyāṁ taṁ parameśvaram
BB 2.2.86.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 86

BB 2.2.87.text:
samādhatsva manaḥ svīyaṁ
tato drakṣyasi taṁ svataḥ
sarvatra bahir antaś ca
sadā sākṣād iva sthitam
BB 2.2.87.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 87

BB 2.2.88.text:
paramātmā vāsudevaḥ
sac-cid-ānanda-vigrahaḥ
nitāntaṁ śodhite citte
sphuraty eṣa na cānyataḥ
sattvaṁ viśuddhaṁ vasudeva-śabditaṁ
yad īyate tatra pumān apāvṛtaḥ
sattve ca tasmin bhagavān vāsudevo
hy adhokṣajo me namasā vidhīyate
BB 2.2.88.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 88

BB 2.2.89.text:
tadānīṁ ca mano-vṛtty-an-
tarābhāvāt su-sidhyati
cetasā khalu yat sākṣāc
cakṣuṣā darśanaṁ hareḥ
BB 2.2.89.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 89

BB 2.2.90.text:
manaḥ-sukhe ’ntar bhavati
sarvendriya-sukhaṁ svataḥ
tad-vṛttiṣv api vāk-cakṣuḥ-
śruty-ādīndriya-vṛttayaḥ
BB 2.2.90.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 90

BB 2.2.91.text:
mano-vṛttiṁ vinā sarve-
ndriyāṇāṁ vṛttayo ’phalāḥ
kṛtāpīhākṛteva syād
ātmany anupalabdhitaḥ
BB 2.2.91.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 91

BB 2.2.92.text:
kadācid bhakta-vātsalyād
yāti ced dṛśyatāṁ dṛśoḥ
jñāna-dṛṣṭyaiva taj jātam
abhimānaḥ paraṁ dṛśoḥ
BB 2.2.92.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 92

BB 2.2.93.text:
tasya kāruṇya-śaktyā vā
dṛśyo ’stv api bahir-dṛśoḥ
tathāpi darśanānandaḥ
sva-yonau jāyate hṛdi
BB 2.2.93.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 93

BB 2.2.94.text:
anantaraṁ ca tatraiva
vilasan paryavasyati
mana eva mahā-pātraṁ
tat-sukha-grahaṇocitam
BB 2.2.94.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 94

BB 2.2.95.text:
tat-prasādodayād yāvat
sukhaṁ vardheta mānasam
tāvad vardhitum īśīta
na cānyad bāhyam indriyam
BB 2.2.95.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 95

BB 2.2.96.text:
antar-dhyānena dṛṣṭo ’pi
sākṣād dṛṣṭa iva prabhuḥ
kṛpā-viśeṣaṁ tanute
pramāṇaṁ tatra padmajaḥ
tasmai sva-lokaṁ bhagavān sabhājitaḥ
sandarśayām āsa paraṁ na yat-param
vyapeta-saṅkleśa-vimoha-sādhvasaṁ
sva-dṛṣṭavadbhir puruṣair abhiṣṭutam
dadarśa tatrākhila-sātvatāṁ patiṁ
śriyaḥ patiṁ yajña-patiṁ jagat-patim
sunanda-nanda-prabalārhaṇādibhiḥ
sva-pārṣadāgraiḥ parisevitaṁ vibhum
bhṛtya-prasādābhimukhaṁ dṛg-āsavaṁ
prasanna-hāsāruṇa-locanānanam
kirīṭinaṁ kuṇḍalinaṁ catur-bhujaṁ
pītāṁśukaṁ vakṣasi lakṣitaṁ śriyā
tad-darśanāhlāda-pariplutāntaro
hṛṣyat-tanuḥ prema-bharāśru-locanaḥ
nanāma pādāmbujam asya viśva-sṛg
yat pāramahaṁsyena pathādhigamyate
taṁ prīyamāṇaṁ samupasthitaṁ kaviṁ
prajā-visarge nija-śāsanārhaṇam
babhāṣa īṣat-smita-śociṣā girā
priyaḥ priyaṁ prīta-manāḥ kare spṛśan
sampradiśyaivam ajano
janānāṁ parameṣṭhinam
paśyatas tasya tad rūpam
ātmano nyaruṇad dhariḥ
kālena so ’jaḥ puruṣāyuṣābhi-
pravṛtta-yogena virūḍha-bodhaḥ
svayaṁ tad antar-hṛdaye ’vabhātam
apaśyatāpaśyata yan na pūrvam
mṛṇāla-gaurāyata-śeṣa-bhoga-
paryaṅka ekaṁ puruṣaṁ śayānam
phaṇātapatrāyuta-mūrdha-ratna-
dyubhir hata-dhvānta-yugānta-toye
sa karma-bījaṁ rajasoparaktaḥ
prajāḥ sisṛkṣann iyad eva dṛṣṭvā
astaud visargābhimukhas tam īḍyam
avyakta-vartmany abhiveśitātmā
mā veda-garbha gās tandrīṁ
sarga udyamam āvaha
tan mayāpāditaṁ hy agre
yan māṁ prārthayate bhavān
prīto ’ham astu bhadraṁ te
lokānāṁ vijayecchayā
yad astauṣīr guṇa-mayaṁ
nirguṇaṁ mānuvarṇayan
BB 2.2.96.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 96

BB 2.2.97.text:
sākṣād darśanam apy asya
bhaktānām eva harṣa-dam
kaṁsa-duryodhanādīnāṁ
bhaya-doṣādinocyate
BB 2.2.97.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 97

BB 2.2.98-99.text:
parānanda-ghanaṁ śrīmat
sarvendriya-guṇāñjanam
nārāyaṇasya rūpaṁ tat
sākṣāt sampaśyatām api
madhu-kaiṭabha-mukhyānām
asurāṇāṁ durātmanām
na līno duṣṭa-bhāvo ’pi
sarva-pīḍā-karo hi yaḥ
BB 2.2.98-99.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 98-99

BB 2.2.100.text:
ānandaka-svabhāvo ’pi
bhakti-māhātmya-darśanāt
bhaktān harṣayituṁ kuryād
durghaṭaṁ ca sa īśvaraḥ
BB 2.2.100.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 100

BB 2.2.101.text:
bhaktau nava-vidhāyāṁ ca
mukhyaṁ smaraṇam eva hi
tat samagrendriya-śreṣṭha-
mano-vṛtti-samarpaṇam
BB 2.2.101.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 101

BB 2.2.102.text:
antar-aṅgāntar-aṅgāṁ tu
prema-bhaktiṁ yathā-ruci
dātum arhaty aviśrāmaṁ
mana eva samāhitam
BB 2.2.102.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 102

BB 2.2.103-105.text:
aśeṣa-sādhanaiḥ sādhyaḥ
samastārthādhikādhikaḥ
yo vaśī-karaṇe gāḍho-
pāyo bhagavato ’dvayaḥ
tat-prasādaika-labhyo yas
tad-bhaktaika-mahā-nidhiḥ
vicitra-paramānanda-
mādhurya-bhara-pūritaḥ
mahā-nirvācya-māhātmyaḥ
padārthaḥ prema-saṁjñakaḥ
pariṇāma-viśeṣe hi
ceto-vṛtter udeti saḥ
BB 2.2.103-105.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 103-105

BB 2.2.106-107.text:
manaso hi samādhānaṁ
manyase duṣkaraṁ yadi
cakṣuḥ-sāphalya-kāmo vā
bhagavantaṁ didṛkṣase
tad gaccha bhārataṁ varṣaṁ
tatra no ’tratyam īśvaram
nārāyaṇaṁ nara-sakhaṁ
paśyādrau gandhamādane
BB 2.2.106-107.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 106-107

BB 2.2.108.text:
antar bahiś ca paśyāmas
taṁ samādhi-parāyaṇāḥ
nāto viccheda-duḥkhaṁ syād
ity agāt tatra sa prabhuḥ
BB 2.2.108.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 108

BB 2.2.109.text:
loka-śikṣā-hitārthaṁ tu
kurvann āste mahat tapaḥ
dhanur-vidyā-gurur brahma-
cāri-veśo jaṭā-dharaḥ
BB 2.2.109.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 109

BB 2.2.110.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
tatraiva gantu-kāmaṁ māṁ
catvāraḥ sanakādayaḥ
paśyātraiva tam ity uktvā
bahu-rūpāṇy adarśayan
BB 2.2.110.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 110

BB 2.2.111.text:
eko nārāyaṇo vṛtto
viṣṇu-rūpo ’paro ’bhavat
anyo yajñeśa-rūpo ’bhūt
paro vividha-rūpavān
BB 2.2.111.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 111

BB 2.2.112.text:
bhayena vepamānas tān
avocaṁ sāñjalir naman
aparāddhaṁ mayā bāḍhaṁ
kṣamadhvaṁ dīna-vatsalāḥ
BB 2.2.112.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 112

BB 2.2.113.text:
spṛṣṭo ’haṁ tair mūrdhni labdhvā samādhiṁ
dṛṣṭāni prāk tāni rūpāṇy apaśyam
vyutthāne ’pi dhyāna-vegāt kadācit
pratyakṣāṇīvānupaśyeyam ārāt
BB 2.2.113.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 113

BB 2.2.114.text:
tato jape ’pi me niṣṭhām
avindata sukhaṁ svataḥ
kintv asyā mādhurī bhūmer
vyākulī-kurute manaḥ
BB 2.2.114.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 114

BB 2.2.115.text:
suṣuptir iva kācin me
kadācij jāyate daśā
tayā jape ’ntarāyaḥ syāt
tat-tad-rūpekṣaṇe tathā
BB 2.2.115.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 115

BB 2.2.116.text:
vilapāmi tato nīlā-
calaṁ jigamiṣāmi ca
tatratyais tais tu tad-vṛttaṁ
pṛccheyāhaṁ sa-sāntvanam
BB 2.2.116.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 116

BB 2.2.117.text:
sa-śokaṁ kathyamānā sā
śrutvāmībhiḥ praśasyate
mayā tathā na budhyeta
duḥkham evānumanyate
BB 2.2.117.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 117

BB 2.2.118.text:
athābhyāsa-balenāntar
bahiś ca jagad-īśvaram
tat-tad-rūpeṇa paśyāmi
pratyakṣam iva sarvataḥ
BB 2.2.118.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 118

BB 2.2.119.text:
kadācit sanakādīṁś ca
dhyāna-niṣṭhā-vaśaṁ gatān
vindatas tāni rūpāṇi
dṛṣṭvāpnomi parāṁ mudam
BB 2.2.119.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 119

BB 2.2.120.text:
tat-tad-rahita-kāle ’pi
na sīdāmi tad-āśayā
itthaṁ cira-dinaṁ tatra
sukhenevāvasaṁ sadā
BB 2.2.120.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 120

BB 2.2.121.text:
kadācit puṣkara-dvīpe
sva-bhaktān kṛpayekṣitum
prasthito haṁsam ārūḍhas
tatrāyātaś catur-mukhaḥ
BB 2.2.121.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 121

BB 2.2.122.text:
paramaiśvarya-sampannaḥ
sa vṛddhaḥ sanakādibhiḥ
sa-sambhramaṁ praṇamyābhi-
pūjito bhakti-namritaiḥ
BB 2.2.122.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 122

BB 2.2.123.text:
āśīrbhir vardhayitvā tān
snehenāghrāya mūrdhasu
kiñcit samanuśiṣyāsau
taṁ dvīpaṁ vegato ’gamat
BB 2.2.123.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 123

BB 2.2.124.text:
tat-tattva-vṛttaṁ sampṛṣṭā
mayāvocan vihasya te
atrāgatyādhunāpīmaṁ
gopa-bālaka vetsi na
BB 2.2.124.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 124

BB 2.2.125.text:
prajāpati-patir brahmā
sraṣṭā viśvasya naḥ pitā
svayam-bhūḥ parame-ṣṭhy eṣa
jagat pāty anuśāsty api
BB 2.2.125.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 125

BB 2.2.126.text:
asya lokas tu satyākhyaḥ
sarvopari virājate
śata-janma-kṛtaiḥ śuddhaiḥ
sva-dharmair labhyate hi yaḥ
BB 2.2.126.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 126

BB 2.2.127.text:
tatra vaikuṇṭha-loko ’sti
yasmin śrī-jagad-īśvaraḥ
sahasra-śīrṣā varteta
sa mahā-puruṣaḥ sadā
BB 2.2.127.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 127

BB 2.2.128.text:
tasya putra iva brahmā
śrūyate na ca bhidyate
brahmaiva līlayā tatra
mūrtibhyāṁ bhāti no matam
BB 2.2.128.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 128

BB 2.2.129.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
tac chrutvā tatra gatvā taṁ
mahā-puruṣam īkṣitum
japaṁ kurvaṁs tapo-loke
niviṣṭo ’ntaḥ-samādhinā
BB 2.2.129.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 129

BB 2.2.130.text:
muhūrtānantaraṁ dṛṣṭī
samunmīlya vyalokayam
brahma-lokāptam ātmānaṁ
taṁ ca śrī-jagad-īśvaram
BB 2.2.130.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 130

BB 2.2.131.text:
śrīmat-sahasra-bhuja-śīrṣa-padaṁ mahāntaṁ
nīlāmbudābham anurūpa-vibhūṣaṇāḍhyam
tejo-nidhiṁ kamala-nābham ananta-bhoga-
talpe śayānam akhilākṣi-mano-’bhirāmam
BB 2.2.131.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 131

BB 2.2.132.text:
saṁvāhyamāna-caraṇaṁ ramayā suparṇe
baddhāñjalau kṛta-dṛśaṁ vidhinārcyamānam
bhūyo vibhūtibhir amuṁ bahu lālayantaṁ
śrī-nārada-praṇaya-bhaktiṣu datta-cittam
BB 2.2.132.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 132

BB 2.2.133.text:
mahā-rahasyaṁ nigamārtha-tattvaṁ
sva-bhakti-mārgaṁ kamalāsanāya
śanair vivṛtyopadiśantam antar
nijālayendrasya virājamānam
BB 2.2.133.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 133

BB 2.2.134.text:
atho tad ākarṇya catur-mukhaṁ ca
pramoda-sampad-vivaśī-bhavantam
anūdya nīcair anumodamānaṁ
muhus tad-aṅghrīn abhivandamānam
BB 2.2.134.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 134

BB 2.2.135.text:
pramoda-vegāt patitaṁ visaṁjñaṁ
vilokya sā mām abhigamya lakṣmīḥ
nināya saṁjñāṁ bahu lālayitvā
sva-bāla-vat pārśvam uta sva-bhartuḥ
BB 2.2.135.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 135

BB 2.2.136.text:
bhagavantaṁ muhuḥ paśyan
praṇamann avadaṁ manaḥ
nijepsitāntam adyāgā
niścalaṁ tvaṁ mudaṁ bhaja
BB 2.2.136.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 136

BB 2.2.137.text:
aśeṣa-śoka-santrāsa-
duḥkha-hīnam idaṁ padam
paramarddhi-parānanda-
nicitaṁ jagad-arcitam
BB 2.2.137.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 137

BB 2.2.138.text:
yādṛśaḥ sambhaved bhrātar
jagad-īśaś ca tādṛśaḥ
bhāty aśeṣa-mahattāyāḥ
parāṁ kāṣṭhāṁ gataḥ sphuṭam
BB 2.2.138.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 138

BB 2.2.139.text:
sneham anvabhavo lakṣmyā
dṛgbhyāṁ paśyādhunā prabhum
māthura-vraja-bhū-śokaṁ
yiyāsāṁ cānyato jahi
BB 2.2.139.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 139

BB 2.2.140.text:
jagad-īśād vidhāteva
lālanaṁ ced abhīpsasi
tan mahā-puruṣādiṣṭa-
mantra-śaktyā phaliṣyati
BB 2.2.140.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 140

BB 2.2.141.text:
nidrā-līlāṁ prabhur bheje
loka-padme ’sya nābhi-je
sṛṣṭi-rītiṁ vidhir vīkṣya
sva-kṛtyāyābhavad bahiḥ
BB 2.2.141.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 141

BB 2.2.142.text:
paśyan prabho rūpam ado mahādbhutaṁ
tan-nābhi-padme yugapat tathā jagat
gūḍhopadeśa-śravaṇāc catur-mukha-
prema-pravāhaṁ ca sukhaṁ tato ’vasam
BB 2.2.142.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 142

BB 2.2.143.text:
kṛtsne loka-traye naṣṭe
rātrāv ekārṇave sati
śeṣopari sukhaṁ śete
bhagavān brahmaṇā samam
BB 2.2.143.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 143

BB 2.2.144.text:
stūyate citra-vākyaiḥ sa
jana-lokādi-vāsibhiḥ
tan mahā-kautukaṁ vīkṣye
brahma-loka-prabhāvataḥ
BB 2.2.144.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 144

BB 2.2.145.text:
antardhāya kadācic cet
kutrāpi bhagavān vrajet
śokaḥ syād āgate cāsmin
sa-mūlaḥ kṣīyate sa naḥ
BB 2.2.145.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 145

BB 2.2.146.text:
ittham ahnāṁ katipaye
prayāte prātar ekadā
kautukād brahmaṇā spṛṣṭaḥ
pheṇa-puñjo ’suro ’bhavat
BB 2.2.146.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 146

BB 2.2.147.text:
tad-bhītyālīyata brahmā
daityo bhagavatā hataḥ
bhayākrānto vidhir naiti
tat-pade ’yuṅkta māṁ prabhuḥ
BB 2.2.147.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 147

BB 2.2.148.text:
ahaṁ tu vaiṣṇavān eva
sṛjaṁs tad-bhakti-vṛddhaye
nyayuñjam adhikāreṣu
vaiṣṇavān eva sarvataḥ
BB 2.2.148.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 148

BB 2.2.149.text:
itas tato mahā-yajñair
aśvamedhādibhir vibhum
sampūjayan mudāṁ pūrair
brahmāṇḍaṁ samapūrayam
BB 2.2.149.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 149

BB 2.2.150-151.text:
pārameṣṭhyena saṁruddho
vedair mūrti-dharair makhaiḥ
purāṇair itihāsaiś cā-
gamais tīrthair maharṣibhiḥ
brahmarṣibhiś ca bahudhā
stūyamāno mahā-madaiḥ
grasyamāno ’pi muñcāmi
na smākiñcanatāṁ nijām
BB 2.2.150-151.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 150-151

BB 2.2.152.text:
tathāpi brāhmya-kṛtyābdhi-
bhaṅga-magno na pūrva-vat
lebhe bhagavato bhakti-
sukhaṁ cintāturāntaraḥ
BB 2.2.152.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 152

BB 2.2.153.text:
dvi-parārdhāyuṣi svasya
śrūyamāṇe ’pi kālataḥ
bhayaṁ syāt kriyamāṇe ca
jape bhūr iyam ārti-dā
BB 2.2.153.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 153

BB 2.2.154.text:
jagad-īśvarataḥ putra-
lālanaṁ tu mahā-sukham
mamānubhavataś citta-
vaikalyaṁ tad vinaśyati
BB 2.2.154.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 154

BB 2.2.155.text:
atyanta-sannikarṣeṇa
pitṛ-buddhyā ca sevayā
kadāpy āgāṁsi jātāni
mṛṣyante prabhuṇā mama
BB 2.2.155.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 155

BB 2.2.156.text:
tathāpy antar-mahodvegaḥ
syāt tato vyañjite śriyā
snehe mātreva hṛṣṭaḥ syām
evaṁ tatrāvasaṁ ciram
BB 2.2.156.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 156

BB 2.2.157.text:
ekadā muktim atrāptam
ekaṁ tal-loka-vāsibhiḥ
saṁślāghyamānam ākarṇya
tān apṛcchaṁ tad adbhutam
BB 2.2.157.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 157

BB 2.2.158.text:
mukteḥ paramam utkarṣaṁ
daurlabhyaṁ ca niśamya tān
sarva-jñān punar aprākṣaṁ
tad-upāyaṁ tad-īpsayā
BB 2.2.158.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 158

BB 2.2.159.text:
bahulopaniṣad-devyaḥ
śruti-smṛtibhir anvitāḥ
ūcur ekena sādhyo ’sau
mokṣo jñānena nānyathā
tam eva viditvāti mṛtyum eti
nānyaḥ panthā vidyate ’yanāya
BB 2.2.159.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 159

BB 2.2.160.text:
kaiścid uktaṁ sa-gāmbhīryaṁ
purāṇair āgamair api
janyate bhagavad-bhaktyā
sukhaṁ jñānaṁ su-durghaṭam
BB 2.2.160.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 160

BB 2.2.161.text:
kiṁ vānuṣṭhitayā samyak
tayaiva su-labho ’sti saḥ
śruti-smṛtīnāṁ kāsāñcit
sammatis tatra lakṣitā
bhaktir dṛḍhā bhaved yasya
deva-deve janārdane
śreyāṁsi tasya sidhyanti
bhakti-manto ’dhikās tataḥ
jīvanti jantavaḥ sarve
yathā mātaram āśritāḥ
tathā bhaktiṁ samāśritya
sarvā jīvanti siddhayaḥ
bhaktyā tv anyayā śakya
aham evaṁ-vidho ’rjuna
jñātuṁ draṣṭuṁ ca tattvena
praveṣṭuṁ ca parantapa
apatyaṁ draviṇaṁ dārā
hārā harmyaṁ hayā gajāḥ
sukhāni svarga-mokṣau ca
na dūre hari-bhaktitaḥ
BB 2.2.161.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 161

BB 2.2.162.text:
vyaktaṁ tāsāṁ vaco ’śrutvā
kruddhāḥ svair āgamādibhiḥ
mahopaniṣadaḥ kāścid
anvamodanta tat sphuṭam
dharmārtha-kāma-mokṣākhyā
puruṣārthā dvijottamāḥ
hari-bhakti-parāṇāṁ vai
sampadyante na saṁśayaḥ
dharmārtha-kāmaiḥ kiṁ tasya
muktis tasya kare sthitā
samasta-jagatāṁ mūle
yasya bhaktiḥ sthirā tvayi
BB 2.2.162.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 162

BB 2.2.163.text:
gūḍhopaniṣadaḥ kāścit
kaiścid gūḍhair mahāgamaiḥ
samaṁ mahā-purāṇaiś ca
tūṣṇīm āsan kṛta-smitāḥ
BB 2.2.163.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 163

BB 2.2.164-165.text:
mokṣo ’nu bhagavan-mantra-
japa-mātrāt su-sidhyati
na veti kaiścid āmnāya-
purāṇādibhir ulbaṇaḥ
āgamānāṁ vivādo ’bhūt
tam asoḍhvā bahir gatāḥ
te purāṇāgamāḥ karṇau
pidhāyopaniṣad-yutāḥ
BB 2.2.164-165.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 164-165

BB 2.2.166.text:
tato mahā-purāṇānāṁ
mahopaniṣadāṁ tathā
mādhya-sthyād āgamānāṁ tu
jayo jāto mama priyaḥ
gatvā gatvā nivartante
candra-sūryādayo grahāḥ
adyāpi na nivartante
dvādaśākṣara-cintakāḥ
japena devatā nityaṁ
stūyamānā prasīdati
prasannā vipulān bhogān
dadyān muktiṁ ca śāśvatīm
BB 2.2.166.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 166

BB 2.2.167.text:
mayābhipretya tad-bhāvaṁ
te purāṇāgamādayaḥ
anunīya sabhā-madhyam
ānītāḥ stuti-pāṭavaiḥ
BB 2.2.167.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 167

BB 2.2.168.text:
tat tattvaṁ sādaraṁ pṛṣṭās
te śrī-bhāgavatādayaḥ
ūcuḥ sātvata-siddhāntādy-
āgamāḥ śruti-maulibhiḥ
BB 2.2.168.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 168

BB 2.2.169.text:
śrī-bhakti-śāstrāṇy ūcuḥ
labdha-brahmādhikāredaṁ
mahā-gopyaṁ nidher api
bhavat-sad-guṇa-sandohair
ākhyāmo mukharī-kṛtāḥ
BB 2.2.169.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 169

BB 2.2.170.text:
kvacit prastūyate ’smābhir
bhagavad-bhakti-tatparaiḥ
mokṣas tyājayituṁ samyag
vinindya sa-paricchadaḥ
BB 2.2.170.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 170

BB 2.2.171.text:
nirvaktuṁ bhakti-māhātmyaṁ
kathyate ’syāpi tat kvacit
na tu sādhya-phalatvena
sukha-gandho ’pi nāsti yat
BB 2.2.171.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 171

BB 2.2.172.text:
yathārogye suṣuptau ca
sukhaṁ mokṣe ’pi kalpyate
paraṁ tv ajñāna-saṁjño ’yam
anabhijña-prarocakaḥ
ajñāna-saṁjñau bhava-bandha-mokṣau
dvau nāma nānyau sta ṛta-jña-bhāvāt
ajasra-city ātmani kevale pare
vicāryamāṇe taraṇāv ivāhanī
BB 2.2.172.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 172

BB 2.2.173.text:
kathañcid bhagavan-nāmā-
bhāsasyāpi sa sidhyati
sakṛd uccāra-mātreṇa
kiṁ vā karṇa-praveśataḥ
etāvatālam agha-nirharaṇāya puṁsāṁ
saṅkīrtanaṁ bhagavato guṇa-karma-nāmnām
vikruśya putram aghavān yad ajāmilo ’pi
nārāyaṇeti mriyamāṇa iyāya muktim
BB 2.2.173.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 173

BB 2.2.174.text:
vicārācāturī-ramyo
mokṣo ’yam avadhāryatām
teṣāṁ veda-purāṇādi-
śāstrāṇāṁ hi yathā-matam
BB 2.2.174.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 174

BB 2.2.175.text:
so ’śeṣa-duḥkha-dhvaṁso vā-
vidyā-karma-kṣayo ’tha vā
māyā-kṛtānyathā-rūpa-
tyāgāt svānubhavo ’pi vā
BB 2.2.175.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 175

BB 2.2.176.text:
jīva-svarūpa-bhūtasya
sac-cid-ānanda-vastunaḥ
sākṣād-anubhavenāpi
syāt tādṛk sukham alpakam
BB 2.2.176.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 176

BB 2.2.177.text:
śuddhātma-tattvaṁ yad vastu
tad eva brahma kathyate
nirguṇaṁ tac ca niḥsaṅgaṁ
nirvikāraṁ nirīhitam
BB 2.2.177.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 177

BB 2.2.178.text:
bhagavāṁs tu paraṁ brahma
parātmā parameśvaraḥ
su-sāndra-sac-cid-ānanda-
vigraho mahimārṇavaḥ
brahman brahmaṇy anirdeśye
nirguṇe guṇa-vṛttayaḥ
kathaṁ caranti śrutayaḥ
sākṣāt sad-asataḥ pare
BB 2.2.178.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 178

BB 2.2.179.text:
saguṇatvāguṇatvādi-
virodhāḥ praviśanti tam
mahā-vibhūtir brahmāsya
prasiddhetthaṁ tayor bhidā
aprasiddhes tad-guṇānām
anāmāsau prakīrtitaḥ
aprākṛtatvād rūpasyāpy
arūpo ’yaṁ pracakṣate
yat kiñcid iha loke vai
deha-bandhaṁ viśām-pate
sarvaṁ pañcabhir āviṣṭaṁ
bhūtair īśvara-buddhi-jaiḥ
īśvaro hi mahad bhūtaṁ
prabhur nārāyaṇo viṛāṭ
bhūtāntar-ātmā vijñeyaḥ
saguṇo nirguṇo ’pi saḥ
asthūlaś cānaṇuś caiva
sthūlo ’ṇuś caiva sarvataḥ
avarṇaḥ sarvataḥ proktaḥ
śyāmo raktānta-locanaḥ
aiśvarya-yogād bhagavān
viruddhārtho ’bhidhīyate
tathāpi doṣāḥ parame
naivāhāryāḥ kathañcana
guṇā viruddhā api tu
samāhāryāś ca sarvataḥ
guṇāḥ sarve ’pi yujyante
hy aiśvaryāt puruṣottame
doṣāḥ kathañcin naivātra
yujyante paramo hi saḥ
guṇa-doṣau māyayaiva
kecid āhur apaṇḍitāḥ
na tatra māyā māyī vā
tadīyau tau kuto hy ataḥ
tasmān na māyayā sarvaṁ
sarvaiśvaryasya sambhavam
amāyo hīśvaro yasmāt
tasmāt taṁ paramaṁ viduḥ
tasyāravinda-nayanasya padāravinda-
kiñjalka-miśra-tulasī-makaranda-vāyuḥ
antar-gataḥ sva-vivareṇa cakāra teṣāṁ
saṅkṣobham akṣara-juṣām api citta-tanvoḥ
yasya prabhā prabhavato jagad-aṇḍa-koṭi-
koṭiṣv aśeṣa-vasudhādi-vibhūti-bhinnam
tad brahma niṣkalam anantam aśeṣa-bhūtaṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
anārambhaṁ tamo yānti
paramātma-vinindanāt
parādhīnaś ca baddhaś ca
svalpa-jñāna-sukhe sthitaḥ
alpa-śaktiḥ sa-doṣaś ca
jīvātmā nedṛśaḥ paraḥ
vadatā tu tayor aikyaṁ
kiṁ tair na duṣkṛtaṁ kṛtam
antaryāmy-aikya-vācīni
vacanānīha yāni hi
tāni dṛṣṭvā bhramantīha
durātmāno ’lpa-cetasaḥ
asy asmi tvam ahaṁ svātmety
abhidhā gocaro yataḥ
sarvāntaratvāt puruṣas
tv antar-yāmī bhidām ayan
ato bhramanti vacanair
asurā moha-tatparaiḥ
tan-mohane parā prītir
devānāṁ paramasya ca
ato mahāndha-tamasi
narake yānty abhedataḥ
BB 2.2.179.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 179

BB 2.2.180.text:
ataḥ sāndra-sukhaṁ tasya
śrīmat-pādāmbuja-dvayam
bhaktyānubhavatāṁ sāndraṁ
sukhaṁ sampadyate dhruvam
eka-deśa-sthitasyāgner
jyotsnā vistāriṇī yathā
parasya brahmaṇaḥ śaktis
tathedam akhilaṁ jagat
BB 2.2.180.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 180

BB 2.2.181.text:
sukha-rūpaṁ sukhādhāraḥ
śarkarā-piṇḍa-van matam
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇa-dvandvaṁ
sukhaṁ brahma tu kevalam
BB 2.2.181.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 181

BB 2.2.182.text:
jīva-svarūpaṁ yad vastu
paraṁ brahma tad eva cet
tad eva sac-cid-ānanda-
ghanaṁ śrī-bhagavāṁś ca tat
BB 2.2.182.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 182

BB 2.2.183.text:
tathāpi jīva-tattvāni
tasyāṁśā eva sammatāḥ
ghana-tejaḥ-samūhasya
tejo-jālaṁ yathā raveḥ
BB 2.2.183.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 183

BB 2.2.184.text:
nitya-siddhās tato jīvā
bhinnā eva yathā raveḥ
aṁśavo visphuliṅgāś ca
vahner bhaṅgāś ca vāridheḥ
BB 2.2.184.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 184

BB 2.2.185.text:
anādi-siddhayā śaktyā
cid-vilāsa-svarūpayā
mahā-yogākhyayā tasya
sadā te bheditās tataḥ
BB 2.2.185.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 185

BB 2.2.186.text:
atas tasmād abhinnās te
bhinnā api satāṁ matāḥ
muktau satyām api prāyo
bhedas tiṣṭhed ato hi saḥ
muktānām api siddhānāṁ
nārāyaṇa-parāyaṇaḥ
su-durlabhaḥ praśāntātmā
koṭiṣv api mahā-mune
BB 2.2.186.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 186

BB 2.2.187.text:
sac-cid-ānanda-rūpāṇāṁ
jīvānāṁ kṛṣṇa-māyayā
anādy-avidyayā tattva-
vismṛtyā saṁsṛtir bhramaḥ
muktau sva-tattva-jñānena
māyāpagamato hi saḥ
nivartate ghanānanda-
brahmāṁśānubhavo bhavet
BB 2.2.187.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 187

BB 2.2.189.text:
sva-sādhanānurūpaṁ hi
phalaṁ sarvatra sidhyati
ataḥ svarūpa-jñānena
sādhye mokṣe ’lpakaṁ phalam
BB 2.2.189.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 189

BB 2.2.190.text:
saṁsāra-yātanodvignai
rasa-hīnair mumukṣubhiḥ
bahudhā stūyate mokṣo
yathā dyauḥ svarga-kāmibhiḥ
yan na duḥkhena sambhinnaṁ
na ca grastam anantaram
abhilāṣopanītaṁ ca
sukhaṁ tat svarga-vāsinām
BB 2.2.190.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 190

BB 2.2.191.text:
sukhasya tu parā kāṣṭhā
bhaktāv eva svato bhavet
tan-maya-śrī-padāmbhoja-
sevināṁ sādhanocitā
BB 2.2.191.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 191

BB 2.2.192.text:
paramātiśaya-prāpta-
mahattā-bodhanāya hi
parā kāṣṭheti śabdyeta
tasyānantasya nāvadhiḥ
BB 2.2.192.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 192

BB 2.2.193.text:
tat sukhaṁ vardhate ’bhīkṣṇam
anantaṁ paramaṁ mahat
na tu brahma-sukhaṁ muktau
vardhate sīmavad yataḥ
BB 2.2.193.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 193

BB 2.2.194.text:
paramātmā para-brahma
sa eva parameśvaraḥ
ity evam eṣām aikyena
sajātīya-bhidā hatā
BB 2.2.194.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 194

BB 2.2.195.text:
sadā vaijātyam āptānāṁ
jīvānām api tattvataḥ
aṁśatvenāpy abhinnatvād
vijātīya-bhidā mṛtā
BB 2.2.195.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 195

BB 2.2.196.text:
asmin hi bhedābhedākhye
siddhānte ’smat-su-sammate
yuktyāvatārite sarvaṁ
niravadyaṁ dhruvaṁ bhavet
saty api bhedāpagame nātha
tavāhaṁ na māmakīnas tvam
sāmudro hi taraṅgaḥ kva-
ca na samudras tāraṅgaḥ
BB 2.2.196.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 196

BB 2.2.197.text:
sadā pramāṇa-bhūtānām
asmākaṁ mahatāṁ tathā
vākyāni vyavahārāś ca
pramāṇaṁ khalu sarvathā
ātmārāmāś ca munayo
nirgranthā apy urukrame
kurvanty ahaitukīṁ bhaktim
ittham-bhūta-guṇo hariḥ
devānāṁ guṇa-liṅgānām
ānuśravika-karmaṇām
sattva evaika-manaso
vṛttiḥ svābhāvikī tu yā
animittā bhāgavatī
bhaktiḥ siddher garīyasī
nārāyaṇa-parāḥ sarve
na kutaścana bibhyati
svargāpavarga-narakeṣv
api tulyārtha-darśinaḥ
duravagamātma-tattva-nigamāya tavātta-tanoś
carita-mahāmṛtābdhi-parivarta-pariśramaṇāḥ
na parilaṣanti kecid apavargam apīśvara te
caraṇa-saroja-haṁsa-kula-saṅga-visṛṣṭa-gṛhāḥ
mahatāṁ madhudviṭ-sevānurakta-manasām abhavo ’pi phalguḥ
bhava-bandha-cchide tasmai
spṛhayāmi na muktaye
bhavān prabhur ahaṁ dāsa
iti yatra vilupyate
BB 2.2.197.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 197

BB 2.2.198.text:
tathaitad-anukūlāni
purā-vṛttāni santi ca
naiva saṅgacchate tasmād
artha-vādatva-kalpanā
tvan-māyayāddhā jana īśa khaṇḍito
yad anyad āśāsta ṛtātmano ’budhaḥ
yathā cared bāla-hitaṁ pitā svayaṁ
tathā tvam evārhasi naḥ samīhitum
ity ādi-rājena nutaḥ sa viśva-dṛk
tam āha rājan mayi bhaktir astu te
diṣṭyedṛśī dhīr mayi te kṛtā yayā
māyāṁ madīyāṁ tarati sma dustyajām
BB 2.2.198.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 198

BB 2.2.199.text:
athāpy ācaryamāṇā sā
nāstikatvaṁ vitanvatī
kṣipet kalpayitāraṁ taṁ
dustare narakotkare
purāṇeṣu dvija-śreṣṭhāḥ
sarva-dharma-pravaktṛṣu
pravadanty artha-vādatvaṁ
ye te naraka-bhājanāḥ
BB 2.2.199.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 199

BB 2.2.200.text:
aho ślāghyaḥ kathaṁ mokṣo
daityānām api dṛśyate
tair eva śāstrair nindyante
ye go-viprādi-ghātinaḥ
tasmāt sarvātmanā rājan
brāhmaṇān brahma-vādinaḥ
tapasvino yajña-śīlān
gāś ca hanmo havir-dughāḥ
BB 2.2.200.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 200

BB 2.2.210.text:
bhakteḥ phalaṁ paraṁ prema
tṛpty-abhāva-svabhāvakam
avāntara-phaleṣv etad
ati-heyaṁ satāṁ matam
BB 2.2.210.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 210

BB 2.2.202.text:
kṛṣṇa-bhaktyaiva sādhutvaṁ
sādhanaṁ paramaṁ hi sā
tayā sādhyaṁ tad-aṅghry-abja-
yugalaṁ paramaṁ phalam
ahaṁ bhakta-parādhīnor
hy asvatantra iva dvija
sādhubhir grasta-hṛdayor
bhaktair bhakta-jana-priyaḥ
sādhavo hṛdayaṁ mahyaṁ
sādhūnāṁ hṛdayaṁ tv aham
mad-anyat te na jānanti
nāhaṁ tebhyo manāg api
BB 2.2.202.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 202

BB 2.2.203.text:
tad-bhakti-rasikānāṁ tu
mahatāṁ tattva-vedinām
sādhyā tac-caraṇāmbhoja-
makarandātmikaiva sā
BB 2.2.203.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 203

BB 2.2.204.text:
sā karma-jñāna-vairāgyā-
pekṣakasya na sidhyati
paraṁ śrī-kṛṣṇa-kṛpayā
tan-mātrāpekṣakasya hi
tat te ’nukampāṁ su-samīkṣamāṇo
bhuñjāna evātma-kṛtaṁ vipākam
hṛd-vāg-vapurbhir vidadhan namas te
jīveta yo mukti-pade sa dāya-bhāk
…apavargaś ca bhavati. yo ’sau bhagavati sarva-bhūtātmany anātmye ’nirukte ’nilayane paramātmani vāsudeve ’nanya-nimitta-bhakti-yoga-lakṣaṇo nānā-gati-nimittāvidyā-granthi-randhana-dvāreṇa yadā hi mahā-puruṣa-puruṣa-prasaṅgaḥ.
nairapekṣyaṁ paraṁ prāhur
niḥśreyasam analpakam
tasmān nirāśiṣo bhaktir
nirapekṣasya me bhavet
varṇāśramācāra-vatār
puruṣeṇa paraḥ pumān
viṣṇur ārādhyate panthār
nānyat tat-toṣa-kāraṇam
śruti-smṛtī mamaivājñer
yas te ullaṅghya vartate
ājñā-cchedī mama drohīr
mad-bhakto ’pi na vaiṣṇavaḥ
mat-karma kurvatāṁ puṁsāṁ
kriyā-lopo bhaved yadi
teṣāṁ karmāṇi kurvanti
tisraḥ koṭyo maharṣayaḥ
yasmin jñāte na kurvanti
karma caiva śrutīritam
nireṣaṇā jagan-mitrāḥ
śuddhaṁ brahma namāmi tam
tāvat karmāṇi kurvīta
na nirvidyeta yāvatā
mat-kathā-śravaṇādau vā
śraddhā yāvan na jāyate
mahāntas te sama-cittāḥ praśāntā vimanyavaḥ suhṛdaḥ sādhavo ye
ye vā mayīśe kṛta-sauhṛdārthā janeṣu dehambhara-vārtikeṣu gṛheṣu jāyātmaja-rāti-matsu na prīti-yuktā yāvad-arthāś ca loke
na mayy ekānta-bhaktānāṁ
guṇa-doṣodbhavā guṇāḥ
sādhūnāṁ sama-cittānāṁ
buddheḥ param upeyuṣām
smartavyaḥ satataṁ viṣṇur
vismartavyo na jātu cit
sarve vidhi-niṣedhāḥ syur
etayor api kiṅkarāḥ
BB 2.2.204.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 204

BB 2.2.205.text:
karma vikṣepakaṁ tasyā
vairāgyaṁ rasa-śoṣakam
jñānaṁ hāni-karaṁ tat tac
chodhitaṁ tv anuyāti tām
tasmān mad-bhakti-yuktasya
yogino vai mad-ātmanaḥ
na jñānaṁ na ca vairāgyaṁ
prāyaḥ śreyo bhaved iha
yat karmabhir yat tapasā
jñāna-vairāgyataś ca yat
yogena dāna-dharmeṇa
śreyobhir itarair api
sarvaṁ mad-bhakti-yogena
mad-bhakto labhate ’ñjasā
svargāpavargaṁ mad-dhāma
kathañcid yadi vāñchati
janmāntara-sahasreṣu
tapo-dāna-samādhibhiḥ
narāṇāṁ kṣīṇa-pāpānāṁ
kṛṣṇe bhaktiḥ prajāyate
BB 2.2.205.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 205

BB 2.2.206.text:
ātmārāmāś ca bhagavat-
kṛpayā bhakta-saṅgataḥ
santyajya brahma-niṣṭhatvaṁ
bhakti-mārgaṁ viśanty ataḥ
BB 2.2.206.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 206

BB 2.2.207.text:
muktāś cāsya tayā śaktyā
sac-cid-ānanda-dehitām
prāpitās te bhajante taṁ
tādṛśaiḥ karaṇair harim
muktānām api siddhānāṁ
nārāyaṇa-parāyaṇaḥ
su-durlabhaḥ praśāntātmā
koṭiṣv api mahā-mune
BB 2.2.207.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 207

BB 2.2.208.text:
svārāmatā tv ahaṅkāra-
tyāga-mātreṇa sidhyati
su-karo ’tīva tat-tyāgo
matas tat-tattva-vedibhiḥ
api puṣpāvadalanād
api netra-nimīlanāt
su-karo ’haṅkṛti-tyāgo
matas tat-tattva-vedibhiḥ
BB 2.2.208.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 208

BB 2.2.209.text:
avāntara-phalaṁ bhakter
eva mokṣādi yady api
tathāpi nātmārāmatvaṁ
grāhyaṁ prema-virodhi yat
BB 2.2.209.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 209

BB 2.2.211.text:
bhaktiṁ vināpi tat-siddhāv
asantoṣo bhaven na tat
śrīmad-bhāgavatendrāṇāṁ
mate sa hi guṇo mahān
BB 2.2.211.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 211

BB 2.2.212.text:
tad-dhetuś citta-śuddhir vā
sva-dharmācāra-bhaktitaḥ
bāhyāyās tv alpakaṁ bhakter
āntaryāḥ su-mahat phalaṁ
BB 2.2.212.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 212

BB 2.2.213.text:
nijātmārāmatā-paścād
bhajatāṁ tat-padāmbujam
nirvighnam acirāt sidhyed
bhakti-niṣṭhā-mahā-sukham
BB 2.2.213.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 213

BB 2.2.214.text:
tatrānubhavitā so ’nu-
bhavanīyo ’nubhūtayaḥ
vṛttayaḥ karaṇānāṁ ca
bahudhā prasphuranti hi
BB 2.2.214.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 214

BB 2.2.215.text:
paraṁ samādhau sukham ekam asphuṭaṁ
vṛtter abhāvān manaso na cātatam
vṛttau sphurad vastu tad eva bhāsate
’dhikaṁ yathaiva sphaṭikācale mahaḥ
na hi paramasya kaścid aparo na paraś ca bhaved
viyata ivāpadasya tava śūnya-tulāṁ dadhataḥ
sadā sarvatrāste nanu vimalam ādyaṁ tava padaṁ
tathāpy ekaṁ stokaṁ na hi bhava-taroḥ patram abhinat
kṣaṇaṁ jihvā-grastaṁ tava tu bhagavan nāma nikhilaṁ
sa-mūlaṁ saṁsāraṁ kaṣati katarat sevyam anayoḥ
BB 2.2.215.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 215

BB 2.2.216.text:
itthaṁ samādhi-jān mokṣāt
sukhaṁ bhaktau paraṁ mahat
tad bhakta-vatsalasyāsya
kṛpā-mādhurya-jṛmbhitam
BB 2.2.216.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 216

BB 2.2.217.text:
sadaika-rūpaṁ bahu-rūpam adbhutaṁ
vimukti-saukhyāt pratiyogi tat sukham
harer mahā-bhakti-vilāsa-mādhurī-
bharātmakaṁ tarkyam atad-vidāṁ na hi
BB 2.2.217.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 217

BB 2.2.218.text:
sadaika-rūpo ’pi sa viṣṇur ātmanas
tathā sva-bhakter janayaty anu-kṣaṇam
vicitra-mādhurya-śataṁ navaṁ navaṁ
tayā sva-śaktyetara-durvitarkyayā
BB 2.2.218.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 218

BB 2.2.219.text:
pāra-brāhmyaṁ madhura-madhuraṁ pārameśyaṁ ca tad vai
bhakteṣv eṣa pravara-karuṇā-prānta-sīmā-prakāśaḥ
teṣāṁ caiṣā niviḍa-madhurānanda-pūrānubhūter
antyāvasthā prakṛtir uditā dhik-kṛta-brāhma-saukhyā
BB 2.2.219.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 219

BB 2.2.220.text:
sva-bhaktānāṁ tat-tad-vividha-madhurānanda-laharī-
sadā-sampatty-arthaṁ bahutara-viśeṣaṁ vitanute
yathā svasmiṁs tat-tat-prakṛti-rahite ’pi dhruva-taraṁ
tathā teṣāṁ citrākhila-karaṇa-vṛtty-ādi-vibhavam
BB 2.2.220.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 220

BB 2.2.221.text:
nityaiśvaryo nitya-nānā-viśeṣo
nitya-śrīko nitya-bhṛtya-prasaṅgaḥ
nityopāstir nitya-loke ’vatu tvāṁ
nityādvaita-brahma-rūpo ’pi kṛṣṇaḥ
BB 2.2.221.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 221

BB 2.2.222.text:
mahā-rase ’smin na budhaiḥ prayujyate
su-komale karkaśa-tarka-kaṇṭakam
tathāpi nirvāṇa-rata-pravṛttaye
navīna-bhakta-pramude pradarśitam
BB 2.2.222.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 222

BB 2.2.223-224.text:
bhavāṁs tu yadi mokṣasya
tucchatvānubhavena hi
viśuddha-bhagavad-bhakti-
niṣṭhā-sampattim icchati
tadā nijaṁ mahā-mantraṁ
tam eva bhajatāṁ param
atrāpīdaṁ mahā-gūḍhaṁ
śṛṇotu hṛdayaṅ-gamam
BB 2.2.223-224.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 223-224

BB 2.2.225.text:
brahmāṇḍāt koṭi-pañcāśad-
yojana-pramitād bahiḥ
yathottaraṁ daśa-guṇāny
aṣṭāv āvaraṇāni hi
BB 2.2.225.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 225

BB 2.2.226.text:
tāny atikramya labhyeta
tan nirvāṇa-padam dhruvam
mahā-kāla-purākhyaṁ yat
kārya-kāraṇa-kālanāt
BB 2.2.226.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 226

BB 2.2.227.text:
tat-svarūpam anirvācyaṁ
kathañcid varṇyate budhaiḥ
sākāraṁ ca nirākāraṁ
yathā-maty-anusārataḥ
tatas tejaḥ prajvalitam
apaśyaṁ tat tadāmbare
sarva-lokaṁ samāviśya
sthitaṁ puruṣa-vigraham
BB 2.2.227.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 227

BB 2.2.228.text:
bhagavat-sevakais tatra
gataiś ca svecchayā param
hṛdy ākāraṁ ghanī-bhūtaṁ
brahma-rūpaṁ tad īkṣyate
BB 2.2.228.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 228

BB 2.2.229.text:
atas tatrāpi bhavato
dīrgha-vāñchā-mahā-phalam
sākṣāt sampatsyate svīya-
mahā-mantra-prabhāvataḥ
BB 2.2.229.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 229

BB 2.2.230.text:
bahu-kāla-vilambaṁ ca
bhavān nāpekṣate ’tra cet
tadā śrī-mathurāyās tāṁ
vraja-bhūmiṁ nijāṁ vraja
BB 2.2.230.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 230

BB 2.2.231.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
teṣām etair vacobhir me
bhaktir vṛddhiṁ gatā prabhau
vicāraś caiṣa hṛdaye
’jani māthura-bhūsura
BB 2.2.231.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 231

BB 2.2.232.text:
bhaktir yasyedṛśī so ’tra
sākṣāt prāpto mayā pitā
taṁ parityajya gantavyam
anyatra bata kiṁ-kṛte
BB 2.2.232.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 232

BB 2.2.233.text:
ittham udvigna-cittaṁ māṁ
bhagavān sa kṛpākaraḥ
sarvāntar-ātma-vṛtti-jñaḥ
samādiśad idaṁ svayam
BB 2.2.233.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 233

BB 2.2.234.text:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
nija-priya-tamāṁ yāhi
māthurīṁ tāṁ vraja-kṣitim
tat-tan-mat-parama-krīḍā-
sthaly-āvali-vibhūṣitām
BB 2.2.234.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 234

BB 2.2.235.text:
yasyāṁ śrī-brahmaṇāpy ātma-
tṛṇa-janmābhiyācyate
parivṛtte ’pi yā dīrgha-
kāle rājati tādṛśī
BB 2.2.235.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 235

BB 2.2.236.text:
tatra mat-parama-preṣṭhaṁ
lapsyase sva-guruṁ punaḥ
sarvaṁ tasyaiva kṛpayā
nitarāṁ jñāsyasi svayam
BB 2.2.236.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 236

BB 2.2.237.text:
mahā-kāla-pure samyag
mām eva drakṣyasi drutam
tatrāpi paramānandaṁ
prāpsyasi sva-manoramam
BB 2.2.237.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 237

BB 2.2.238.text:
mat-prasāda-prabhāveṇa
yathā-kāmam itas tataḥ
bhramitvā paramāścarya-
śatāny anubhaviṣyasi
BB 2.2.238.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 238

BB 2.2.239.text:
kālena kiyatā putra
paripūrṇākhilārthakaḥ
vṛndāvane mayā sārdhaṁ
krīḍiṣyasi nijecchayā
BB 2.2.239.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 239

BB 2.2.240.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
evaṁ tad-ājñayā harṣa-
śokāviṣṭo ’ham āgataḥ
etad vṛndāvanaṁ śrīmat
tat-kṣaṇān manaseva hi
BB 2.2.240.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 2, Text 240

BB 2.3.1.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
brahma-lokād imāṁ pṛthvīm
āgacchan dṛṣṭavān aham
pūrvaṁ yatra yadāsīt tad-
gandho ’py asti na kutracit
BB 2.3.1.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 1

BB 2.3.2.text:
paraṁ śrī-mathurā tādṛg-
vanādri-sarid-anvitā
virājate yathā-pūrvaṁ
tādṛśair jaṅgamair vṛtā
BB 2.3.2.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 2

BB 2.3.3.text:
ājñāṁ bhagavataḥ smṛtvā
bhraman vṛndāvanāntare
anviṣya kuñje ’trāpaśyaṁ
sva-guruṁ prema-mūrchitam
BB 2.3.3.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 3

BB 2.3.4.text:
prayāsair bahubhiḥ svāsthyaṁ
nīto ’sau vīkṣya māṁ natam
parirebhe ’tha sarva-jño
bubudhe man-manoratham
BB 2.3.4.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 4

BB 2.3.5.text:
snātvā sva-datta-mantrasya
dhyānādi-vidhim uddiśan
kiñcin mukhena kiñcic ca
saṅketenābhyavedayat
BB 2.3.5.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 5

BB 2.3.6.text:
jagāda ca nijaṁ sarvam
idaṁ preṣṭhāya te ’dadām
sarvam etat-prabhāveṇa
svayaṁ jñāsyasi lapsyase
BB 2.3.6.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 6

BB 2.3.7.text:
harṣeṇa mahatā tasya
pādayoḥ patite mayi
so ’ntarhita ivāgacchad
yatra kutrāpy alakṣitam
BB 2.3.7.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 7

BB 2.3.8.text:
ahaṁ ca tad-viyogārtaṁ
mano viṣṭabhya yatnataḥ
yathādeśaṁ sva-mantraṁ taṁ
pravṛtto japtum ādarāt
BB 2.3.8.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 8

BB 2.3.9.text:
pāñca-bhautikatātītaṁ
sva-dehaṁ kalayan raveḥ
nirbhidya maṇḍalaṁ gacchann
ūrdhvaṁ lokān vyalokayam
BB 2.3.9.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 9

BB 2.3.10.text:
dūṣitān bahu-doṣeṇa
sukhābhāsena bhūṣitān
māyā-mayān mano-rājya-
svapna-dṛṣṭārtha-sammitān
BB 2.3.10.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 10

BB 2.3.11.text:
pūrvaṁ ye bahu-kālena
samprāptāḥ kramaśo ’dhunā
sarve nimeṣataḥ krāntā
yugapan manaseva te
BB 2.3.11.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 11

BB 2.3.12.text:
brahma-lokāt sukhaiḥ koṭi-
guṇitair uttarottaram
vaibhavaiś ca mahiṣṭhāni
prāpto ’smy āvaraṇāny atha
BB 2.3.12.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 12

BB 2.3.13-14.text:
kāryopādhim atikrāntaiḥ
prāptavya-krama-muktikaiḥ
liṅgākhyaṁ kāraṇopādhim
atikramitum ātmabhiḥ
praviśya tat-tad-rūpeṇa
bhujyamānāni kāmataḥ
tat-tad-udbhava-niḥśeṣa-
sukha-sāra-mayāni hi
BB 2.3.13-14.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 13-14

BB 2.3.15-16.text:
pṛthivy-āvaraṇaṁ teṣu
prathamaṁ gatavān aham
tad-aiśvaryādhikāriṇyā
dharaṇyā pūjitaṁ prabhum
brahmāṇḍa-durlabhair dravyair
mahā-śūkara-rūpiṇam
apaśyaṁ prati-romānta-
bhramad-brahmāṇḍa-vaibhavam
BB 2.3.15-16.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 15-16

BB 2.3.17.text:
tasyāṁ kāraṇa-rūpāyāṁ
kārya-rūpam idaṁ jagat
tad-upādānakaṁ sarvaṁ
sphūritaṁ ca vyalokayam
BB 2.3.17.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 17

BB 2.3.18.text:
vidhāya bhagavat-pūjāṁ
tayātithyena sat-kṛtaḥ
dināni katicit tatra
bhogārtham aham arthitaḥ
BB 2.3.18.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 18

BB 2.3.19.text:
tām anujñāpya kenāpy ā-
kṛṣyamāṇa ivāśu tat
atītyāvaraṇaṁ prāptaḥ
parāṇy āvaraṇāni ṣaṭ
BB 2.3.19.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 19

BB 2.3.20-21.text:
mahā-rūpa-dharair vāri-
tejo-vāyv-ambarais tathā
ahaṅkāra-mahadbhyāṁ ca
sva-svāvaraṇato ’rcitam
krameṇa matsyaṁ sūryaṁ ca
pradyumnam aniruddhakam
saṅkarṣaṇaṁ vāsudevaṁ
bhagavantam alokayam
BB 2.3.20-21.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 20-21

BB 2.3.22.text:
sva-kāryāt pūrva-pūrvasmāt
kāraṇaṁ cottarottaram
pūjya-pūjaka-bhoga-śrī-
mahattvenādhikādhikam
BB 2.3.22.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 22

BB 2.3.23.text:
pūrva-vat tāny atikramya
prakṛty-āvaraṇaṁ gataḥ
mahā-tamo-mayaṁ sāndra-
śyāmikākṣi-manoharam
paṅka-bhūtaṁ hi timiraṁ
sparśād vijñāyate ghanāḥ
atha parvata-bhūtaṁ tu
timiraṁ samapadyata
sapta dvīpān sa-sindhūṁś ca
sapta sapta girīn atha
lokālokaṁ tathātītya
viveśa su-mahat tamaḥ
tatrāśvāḥ śaibya-sugrīva-
meghapuṣpa-balāhakāḥ
tamasi bhraṣṭa-gatayo
babhūvur bharatarṣabha
tān dṛṣṭvā bhagavān kṛṣṇo
mahā-yogeśvareśvaraḥ
sahasrāditya-saṅkāśaṁ
sva-cakraṁ prāhiṇot puraḥ
BB 2.3.23.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 23

BB 2.3.24.text:
tasmin nijeṣṭa-devasya
varṇa-sādṛśyam ātate
dṛṣṭvāhaṁ nitarāṁ hṛṣṭo
naicchaṁ gantuṁ tato ’grataḥ
BB 2.3.24.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 24

BB 2.3.25.text:
śrī-mohinī-mūrti-dharasya tatra
vibhrājamānasya nijeśvarasya
pūjāṁ samāpya prakṛtiḥ prakṛṣṭa-
mūrtiḥ sapady eva samabhyayān mām
BB 2.3.25.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 25

BB 2.3.26.text:
upānayan mahā-siddhīr
aṇimādyā mamāgrataḥ
yayāce ca pṛthivy-ādi-
vat tatra mad-avasthitim
BB 2.3.26.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 26

BB 2.3.27.text:
sa-snehaṁ ca jagādedaṁ
yadi tvaṁ muktim icchasi
tadāpy anugṛhāṇemāṁ
māṁ tasyāḥ pratihāriṇīm
BB 2.3.27.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 27

BB 2.3.28.text:
bhaktim icchasi vā viṣṇos
tathāpy etasya ceṭikām
bhaginīṁ śakti-rūpāṁ māṁ
kṛpayā bhaja bhakti-dām
BB 2.3.28.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 28

BB 2.3.29.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
tad aśeṣam anādṛtya
viṣṇu-śakti-dhiyā param
tāṁ natvāvaraṇaṁ ramya-
varṇaṁ tad draṣṭum abhramam
BB 2.3.29.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 29

BB 2.3.30.text:
prādhānikair jīva-saṅghair
bhujyamānaṁ mano-ramam
sarvataḥ sarva-māhātmyā-
dhikyena vilasat svayam
BB 2.3.30.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 30

BB 2.3.31.text:
bahu-rūpaṁ durvibhāvyaṁ
mahā-mohana-vaibhavam
kārya-kāraṇa-saṅghātaiḥ
sevyamānaṁ jagan-mayam
BB 2.3.31.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 31

BB 2.3.32.text:
atheśvarecchayātītya
durantaṁ tad ghanaṁ tamaḥ
tejaḥ-puñjam apaśyantaṁ
dṛṅ-nimīlana-kārakam
BB 2.3.32.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 32

BB 2.3.33.text:
bhaktyā paramayā yatnād
agre dṛṣṭī prasārayan
sūrya-koṭi-pratīkāśam
apaśyaṁ parameśvaram
BB 2.3.33.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 33

BB 2.3.34.text:
mano-dṛg-ānanda-vivardhanaṁ vibhuṁ
vicitra-mādhurya-vibhūṣaṇācitam
samagra-sat-puruṣa-lakṣaṇānvitaṁ
sphurat-para-brahma-mayaṁ mahādbhutam
BB 2.3.34.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 34

BB 2.3.35.text:
sadā guṇātītam aśeṣa-sad-guṇaṁ
nirākṛtiṁ loka-manoramākṛtim
prakṛtyādhiṣṭhātṛtayā vilāsinaṁ
tadīya-sambandha-vihīnam acyutam
BB 2.3.35.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 35

BB 2.3.36.text:
mahā-sambhrama-santrāsa-
pramoda-bhara-vihvalaḥ
tadā kiṁ karavāṇīti
jñātuṁ neśe kathañcana
BB 2.3.36.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 36

BB 2.3.37.text:
yady api sva-prakāśo ’sāv
atītendriya-vṛttikaḥ
tat-kāruṇya-prabhāveṇa
paraṁ sākṣāt samīkṣyate
BB 2.3.37.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 37

BB 2.3.38.text:
naitan niścetum īśe ’yaṁ
dṛgbhyāṁ cittena vekṣyate
kiṁ vātikramya tat sarvam
ātma-bhāvena kenacit
BB 2.3.38.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 38

BB 2.3.40.text:
kadāpi tasminn evāhaṁ
līyamāno ’nukampayā
rakṣeya nija-pādābja-
nakhāṁśu-sparśato ’munā
BB 2.3.40.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 40

BB 2.3.41.text:
bhinnābhinnair mahā-siddhaiḥ
sūkṣmaiḥ sūryam ivāṁśubhiḥ
vṛtaṁ bhaktair ivālokya
kadāpi prīyate manaḥ
BB 2.3.41.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 41

BB 2.3.42.text:
ittham ānanda-sandoham
anuvindan nimagna-dhīḥ
ātmārāma ivābhūvaṁ
pūrṇa-kāma ivātha vā
BB 2.3.42.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 42

BB 2.3.43.text:
tarkārcita-vicāraughair
idam eva paraṁ padam
parāṁ kāṣṭhāṁ gataṁ caitad
amaṁsi paramaṁ phalam
BB 2.3.43.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 43

BB 2.3.44.text:
pada-svābhāvikānanda-
taraṅga-kṣobha-vihvale
citte tad-anya-sva-prāpya-
jñānam antardadhāv iva
BB 2.3.44.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 44

BB 2.3.45.text:
śrīman-mahā-bhāgavatopadeśataḥ
san-mantra-sevā-balato na kevalam
līnā kadācin nija-pūjya-devatā-
pādābja-sākṣād-avaloka-lālasā
BB 2.3.45.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 45

BB 2.3.46.text:
utāsya tejo-maya-pūruṣasya
cirāvalokena vivardhito ’bhūt
nijeṣṭa-sandarśana-dīrgha-lobhaḥ
smṛteḥ sṛtiṁ nīta iva prakarṣāt
BB 2.3.46.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 46

BB 2.3.47.text:
tena taṁ prakaṭaṁ paśyann
api prīye na pūrva-vat
sīdāmy atha layaṁ svasya
śaṅkamānaḥ svayam-bhavam
BB 2.3.47.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 47

BB 2.3.48.text:
vraja-bhūmāv ihāgatya
sādhaye ’haṁ sva-vāñchitam
vimṛśann evam aśrauṣaṁ
gīta-vādyādbhuta-dhvanim
BB 2.3.48.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 48

BB 2.3.49.text:
hṛṣṭo ’haṁ paritaḥ paśyan
vṛṣārūḍhaṁ vyalokayam
kam apy ūrdhva-padāt tatrā-
yāntaṁ sarva-vilakṣaṇam
BB 2.3.49.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 49

BB 2.3.50.text:
karpūra-gauraṁ tri-dṛśaṁ dig-ambaraṁ
candrārdha-mauliṁ lalitaṁ tri-śūlinam
gaṅgā-jalāmlāna-jaṭāvalī-dharaṁ
bhasmāṅga-rāgaṁ rucirāsthi-mālinam
BB 2.3.50.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 50

BB 2.3.51.text:
gauryā nijāṅkāśritayānurañjitaṁ
divyāti-divyaiḥ kalitaṁ paricchadaiḥ
ātmānurūpaiḥ parivāra-sañcayaiḥ
saṁsevyamānaṁ rucirākṛtīhitaiḥ
BB 2.3.51.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 51

BB 2.3.52.text:
paramaṁ vismayaṁ prāpto
harṣaṁ caitad acintayam
ko nv ayaṁ pārivārāḍhyo
bhāti mukti-padopari
BB 2.3.52.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 52

BB 2.3.53.text:
jagad-vilakṣaṇaiśvaryo
mukta-vargādhiko ’pi san
lakṣyate ’ti-sad-ācāro
mahā-viṣayavān iva
BB 2.3.53.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 53

BB 2.3.54.text:
parānanda-bharākrānta-
cetās tad-darśanād aham
naman sa-parivāraṁ taṁ
kṛpayālokito ’munā
BB 2.3.54.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 54

BB 2.3.55.text:
harṣa-vegād upavrajya
śrīman-nandīśvarāhvayam
apṛcchaṁ tad-gaṇādhyakṣaṁ
tad-vṛttāntaṁ viśeṣataḥ
BB 2.3.55.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 55

BB 2.3.56.text:
sa sa-hāsam avocan māṁ
gopālopāsanā-para
gopa-bāla na jānīṣe
śrī-śivaṁ jagad-īśvaram
BB 2.3.56.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 56

BB 2.3.57.text:
bhukter mukteś ca dātāyaṁ
bhagavad-bhakti-vardhanaḥ
muktānām api sampūjyo
vaiṣṇavānāṁ ca vallabhaḥ
BB 2.3.57.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 57

BB 2.3.58-59.text:
śiva-kṛṣṇāpṛthag-dṛṣṭi-
bhakti-labhyāt sva-lokataḥ
svānurūpāt kuverasya
sakhyur bhakti-vaśī-kṛtaḥ
kailāsādrim alaṅkartuṁ
pārvatyā priyayānayā
samaṁ parimitair yāti
priyaiḥ parivṛtair vṛtaḥ
BB 2.3.58-59.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 58-59

BB 2.3.60.text:
śrī-gopa-kumāra uvāca
tad ākarṇya prahṛṣṭo ’ham
aicchaṁ tasmān maheśvarāt
prasādaṁ kam api prāptum
ātmano hṛdayaṅ-gamam
BB 2.3.60.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 60

BB 2.3.61.text:
jñātvā bhagavatā tena
dṛṣṭyādiṣṭasya nandinaḥ
upadeśena śuddhena
svayaṁ me ’sphurad añjasā
BB 2.3.61.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 61

BB 2.3.62.text:
śrīman-madana-gopālān
nija-prāṇeṣṭa-daivatāt
abhinnaḥ śrī-maheśo ’yam
uta tad-bhāva-vardhanaḥ
BB 2.3.62.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 62

BB 2.3.63.text:
sukhaṁ tad-gaṇa-madhye ’haṁ
praviṣṭaḥ prīṇito ’khilaiḥ
śaivaiḥ śrī-nandino ’śrauṣaṁ
vṛttam etad vilakṣaṇam
BB 2.3.63.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 63

BB 2.3.64.text:
sadaika-rūpo bhagavān śivo ’yaṁ
vasan sva-loke prakaṭaḥ sadaiva
vilokyate tatra nivāsa-tuṣṭais
tad-eka-niṣṭhaiḥ satataṁ nijeṣṭaiḥ
BB 2.3.64.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 64

BB 2.3.65.text:
svābhinna-bhagavad-bhakti-
lāmpaṭyaṁ grāhayann iva
sadā ramayati svīyān
nṛtya-gītādi-kautukaiḥ
BB 2.3.65.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 65

BB 2.3.66.text:
bhagavantaṁ sahasrāsyaṁ
śeṣa-mūrtiṁ nija-priyam
nityam arcayati premṇā
dāsa-vaj jagad-īśvaraḥ
bhavānī-nāthaiḥ strī-gaṇārbuda-sahasrair avarudhyamāno bhagavataś catur-mūrter mahā-puruṣasya turīyāṁ tāmasīṁ mūrtiṁ prakṛtim ātmanaḥ saṅkarṣaṇa-saṁjñām ātma-samādhi-rūpeṇa sannidhāpyaitad abhigṛṇan bhava upadhāvati.
BB 2.3.66.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 66

BB 2.3.67.text:
jñātvemaṁ śiva-lokasya
viśeṣaṁ sarvato ’dhikam
pramodaṁ paramaṁ prāpto
’py apūrṇaṁ hṛd alakṣayam
BB 2.3.67.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 67

BB 2.3.68.text:
tan-nidānam anāsādya
sadyo ’jñāsiṣam āmṛśan
śrīman-guru-prasādāpta-
vastu-sevā-prabhāvataḥ
BB 2.3.68.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 68

BB 2.3.69.text:
śrīman-madana-gopāla-
deva-pāda-sarojayoḥ
līlādy-anubhavābhāvo
mām ayaṁ bādhate kila
BB 2.3.69.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 69

BB 2.3.70.text:
abodhayaṁ mano ’nena
maheśenaiva sā khalu
līlā-viśeṣa-vaicitrī
kṛtā mūrti-viśeṣataḥ
BB 2.3.70.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 70

BB 2.3.71.text:
tathāpy asvastham ālakṣya
sva-cittam idam abruvam
yady asmin nānubhūyeta
sā tad-rūpādi-mādhurī
BB 2.3.71.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 71

BB 2.3.72.text:
tathāpi dīrgha-vāñchā te
’nugrahād asya setsyati
acirād iti manyasva
sva-prasāda-viśeṣataḥ
BB 2.3.72.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 72

BB 2.3.73.text:
evaṁ tuṣṭa-manās tasya
tatra kenāpi hetunā
viśrāntasya maheśasya
pārśve ’tiṣṭhaṁ kṣaṇaṁ sukham
BB 2.3.73.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 73

BB 2.3.74.text:
tarhy eva bhagavan dūre
keṣām api mahātmanām
saṅgīta-dhvanir atyanta-
madhuraḥ kaścid udgataḥ
BB 2.3.74.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 74

BB 2.3.75.text:
taṁ śrutvā paramānanda-
sindhau magno maheśvaraḥ
mahā-prema-vikārāttaḥ
pravṛtto nartituṁ svayam
BB 2.3.75.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 75

BB 2.3.76.text:
pati-vratottamā sā tu
devī nandy-ādibhiḥ saha
prabhum utsāhayām āsa
vādya-saṅkīrtanādibhiḥ
BB 2.3.76.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 76

BB 2.3.77.text:
sadya evāgatāṁs tatrā-
drākṣaṁ cāru-catur-bhujān
śrīmat-kaiśora-saundarya-
mādhurya-vibhavācitān
BB 2.3.77.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 77

BB 2.3.78.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 78

BB 2.3.79.text:
anirvācya-tamāṁś ceto-
hāri-sarva-paricchadān
saṅgatān pūrva-dṛṣṭais taiś
caturbhiḥ sanakādibhiḥ
BB 2.3.79.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 79

BB 2.3.80.text:
tad-darśana-svabhāvottha-
praharṣākṛṣṭa-mānasaḥ
nājñāsiṣaṁ kim apy antar
bahiś cānyan nija-priyam
BB 2.3.80.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 80

BB 2.3.81.text:
kṣaṇāt svastho ’py aho teṣāṁ
dāsatvam api cetasā
nāśakaṁ yācituṁ bhītyā
lajjayā ca su-durghaṭam
BB 2.3.81.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 81

BB 2.3.82-83.text:
eṣā hi lālasā nūnaṁ
kṛpaṇaṁ mām abādhata
sambhāṣerann ime kiṁ māṁ
śivasya kṛpayā sakṛt
kutratyāḥ katame vaite
kṛpāpāṅgena pāntu mām
yān āliṅgya bhṛśaṁ rudraḥ
prema-mūrcchām ayaṁ vrajet
BB 2.3.82-83.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 82-83

BB 2.3.84.text:
ity-ādi-man-mano-vṛttaṁ
jñātvā devyomayeritaḥ
śiva-cittānuvartinyā
gaṇeśo ’kathayac chanaiḥ
BB 2.3.84.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 84

BB 2.3.85.text:
śrī-gaṇeśa uvāca
ete vaikuṇṭha-nāthasya
śrī-kṛṣṇasya mahā-prabhoḥ
pārṣadāḥ prāpta-sārūpyā
vaikuṇṭhād āgatāḥ kila
BB 2.3.85.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 85

BB 2.3.86-87.text:
paśyeme ’py apare yānti
brahmaṇo ’dhikṛte ’lpake
brahmāṇḍe catur-āsyasya
tathāmī dūrataḥ pare
amī cāṣṭa-mukhasyaitad-
dvi-guṇe yānti vegataḥ
amī tu ṣoḍaśāsyasya
brahmāṇḍe dvi-guṇe tataḥ
BB 2.3.86-87.source: Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, Volume 1, Chapter 3, Text 86-87

BB 2.3.88-89.text:
ity evaṁ koṭi-koṭīnāṁ
brahmaṇāṁ mahatāṁ kramāt
koṭi-koṭi-mukhābjānāṁ
tādṛg-brahmāṇḍa-koṭiṣu
gacchato līlayā tat-tad-
anurūpa-paricchadān
gaṇeśo ’darśayat tān māṁ
bahuśo dṛṅ-manoharān
kvāhaṁ tamo-mahad-ahaṁ-kha-carāgni-vār-bhū-
saṁveṣṭitāṇḍa-ghaṭa-sapta-vitasti-kāyaḥ
kvedṛg-vidhāvigaṇitāṇḍa-parāṇu-caryā-
vātādhva-roma-vivarasya ca te mahitvam
dyu-pataya eva te na yayur antam anantatayā
tvam api yad-antarāṇḍa-nicayā nanu sāvaraṇāḥ
kha iva rajāṁsi vānti vayasā saha yac chrutayas
tvayi hi phalanty atan-nirasanena bhavan-nidhanāḥ
kṣity-ādibhir eṣa kilāvṛtaḥ
saptabhir daśa-guṇottarair aṇḍa-kośaḥ
yatra pataty aṇu-kalpaḥ
sahāṇḍa-koṭi-koṭibhis tad anantaḥ
